jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
See the whole picture. Keep complex work moving.

At Tangent Design Engineering, we bring bold ideas to life. Our team thrives on solving complex problems with elegant engineering, from robotics and energy systems to advanced communications. We are collaborative, curious, and relentless about quality.

We are looking for a Project Manager
who can bring structure, visibility, and calm momentum to multidisciplinary engineering projects. This role is central to how we keep clients informed, teams aligned, and projects moving in the right direction.

You do not need to be the technical expert in the room. That is what our engineers and Technical Product Managers are here for. Your job is to understand the full project picture, communicate the real state of the work, flag risks early, and make sure important details do not quietly fall through the cracks.

This role will also support Tangent’s inside sales activities by helping coordinate opportunities, proposals, follow-up, project handoffs, and the information needed to move prospective work forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead multiple engineering projects in alignment with Tangent’s proposals and project delivery expectations.
Maintain accurate project schedules, budgets, status updates, documentation, and tracking tools so project health is clear and visible.
Serve as the primary client contact for project status, schedule, scope updates, budget communication, and overall project coordination.
Partner with Technical Project Managers, engineers, Client Relationship Managers, and internal leaders to keep work aligned and moving.
Identify early signs of scope, schedule, budget, resource, or delivery risk and communicate them before they become bigger problems.
Support project change orders, invoicing accuracy, project closeouts, and lessons learned.
Lead internal project meetings, track action items, and make sure follow-through actually happens.
Support inside sales activities, including opportunity tracking, proposal coordination, client follow-up, gathering project information, and helping move prospective work through the sales process.
Help create a clean handoff from sales into project delivery so commitments, assumptions, timelines, and client expectations are understood.
Contribute to improvements in Tangent’s project management, proposal, sales coordination, and client communication processes.

What We Expect to See on Your Resume

Project Management Experience
: Experience managing engineering, manufacturing, product development, or technical projects with multiple moving pieces.
Project Control
: Evidence that you have maintained ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risks, actions, and project documentation.
Client Communication
: Experience communicating directly with clients about project realities, timelines, changes, and risks.
Cross-Functional Coordination
: A track record of working with technical teams, operations, finance, leadership, sales, or external stakeholders to keep projects aligned.
Financial and Schedule Visibility
: Experience tracking project budgets, forecasts, timelines, change orders, or invoicing inputs.
Structured Project Delivery
: Familiarity with project management tools, documentation practices, and structured delivery environments.
Sales or Proposal Support
: Experience supporting proposals, opportunity tracking, client follow-up, sales administration, estimating coordination, or project handoffs would be an asset.

What We Will Test for in the Interview

Communication
: Can you explain the real state of a project clearly, calmly, and without burying the useful information?
Accountability
: Do you follow through, close loops, flag concerns early, and take ownership without needing to be chased?
Judgment
: Can you tell the difference between a normal project bump, a real risk, and something that needs escalation?
Client Confidence
: Can you build trust with clients by being transparent, prepared, and steady, especially when timelines, budgets, or scope start to shift?
Team Alignment
: Can you work with technical teams without trying to overstep, while still making sure decisions, actions, and risks are visible?
Commercial Awareness
: Can you support proposals and client opportunities while keeping commitments realistic, details organized, and handoffs clean?
Sales Follow-Through
: Can you keep opportunities moving, coordinate input from busy people, and make sure prospective clients do not disappear into a black hole?

Why Work With Tangent

Salary:
$80,000 to $105,000
Hours:
Full-time, 40 hours per week, with work-from-home flexibility
Paid Time Off:
Four weeks, to be used in any way you want
Benefits:
Health and dental, life insurance, and disability insurance
Culture:
A team that values innovation, accountability, client success, and teamwork
Ready to keep complex engineering work moving without letting chaos drive the bus? Apply now and join Tangent in shaping what’s next.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment, NA
jobs.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview

This role will be based in Nevada, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).

The Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment is responsible for managing the seamless transition of new data centers to Site Operations teams and ensuring Operational Readiness at Site Turnover from Construction. Requirements for this position include a strong understanding of data center facility operations, best practices, and site critical systems, combined with the ability to plan, track, and deliver multiple concurrent deployment projects on time and within defined operational quality standards.

This position is highly cross-functional, interfacing with peer teams in Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and Site Operations, requiring engagement at multiple levels of management throughout the company. This role demands both project management skill and technical acumen, as responsibilities include technical document reviews (e.g., Test and Balance (TAB) reports, commissioning documentation), verification of system performance, and ensuring operational standards are met prior to turnover.

This role is open on a rolling basis, and we review applications as they come in. There’s no set deadline, but if you’re interested, we encourage you to apply soon—our hiring needs can shift, and we welcome applications at any time while the opportunity is available.

Essential Job Functions

Act as a key point of contact coordinating Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and Site Operations teams to seamlessly transition new data centers to Site Operations.
Develop and manage detailed deployment project schedules, milestone tracking, and risk mitigation plans for site readiness activities.
Perform technical reviews of commissioning documentation, TAB reports, and other turnover deliverables to validate operational performance and compliance with design intent.
Manage the recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and training of new Operations teams at greenfield sites, contributing to the effective operational launch of these locations.
Ensure complete program-level Operations protocols, procedures, and standards are in place for newly built facilities to achieve Operational Readiness.
Ensure quality of Commissioning and Facility Acceptance necessary to deliver a technically sound facility to Site Operations.

Duties And Responsibilities

Maintain communication and collaborate with stakeholders during all phases of a new data center build.
Manage schedules and facilitate cross-team engagement keeping pace with Construction delivery dates.
Track project deliverables against defined timelines and escalate risks/issues with recommended mitigation strategies.
Ensure timely completion of Ops Site Deployment quality control checklists and Site Start-Up processes.
Compile Procedures (MOP, SOP, EOP Templates) for Site Start Up across all Sites in deployment and adapt MOP, SOP, EOP templates to Site Specifics.
Ensure the readiness of Operations Support spaces including Tool shop, Critical Spares storage spaces.
Ensure the site is safe to operate with Safety Protocols, Safety Equipment, and Signage in place.
Ensure Billing System Readiness and cross-functional contributions are fully coordinated.
Ensure Asset Management Systems are in place and Site Equipment is fully accounted for including Warranty and Spare Parts information.
Ensure CMMS is fully populated with equipment data and maintenance scheduling plans.
Ensure the Site Security Systems are fully deployed at Site Turnover.
Ensure Site Operators are fully trained and ready to operate and maintain critical systems.
Ensure Permits, Licenses, Agreements are in place to facilitate Operations.
Ensure 3rd party maintenance suppliers and contract agreements are set-up prior to Site Turnover.
Support site mobilization including procuring spares, tools, and consumables.
Lead formal technical review of O&M manuals, as-built & record drawings, permits, certificates, warranty documents, and commissioning reports prior to turnover.
Perform site walks and site turnover walks to ensure Operational Readiness requirements are met.
Share lessons learned that have been captured for consideration/mitigation in future builds.
Coordinate and facilitate the formal transfer of site responsibility from Construction to Operations.

Job Requirements

3+ years of combined experience in data center or mission-critical project management and technical operations.
Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects with defined schedules, budgets, and technical acceptance criteria.
2+ years of experience in a technical role in Critical Facilities Operations or Maintenance Operations with exposure to mechanical, electrical, and controls systems, OR
2+ years of experience in industrial Construction or Commissioning in a technical capacity, OR
2+ years of Project Management experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Proficiency in interpreting and reviewing technical documents such as commissioning reports, TAB reports, electrical and mechanical drawings, and equipment submittals.
Excellent time management and organizational skills and the ability to define these areas for other teams and team members.
Ability to create teams from various departments and work in a high-level collaborative environment while promoting a teamwork mentality.
Ability to initiate, drive, and deliver projects, and communicate plans and findings to internal customers and stakeholders.
Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification preferred.
Ability to travel up to 30% of total work time, including internationally in North America.

Physical Demands And Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager (Security & Compliance)
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (Security & Compliance). This position is remote-friendly.

Position Overview

At Alteryx, we put data and AI to work for the intelligent enterprise. Alteryx One connects data, governed business logic, and AI-driven insights and actions in a scalable platform.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to coordinate complex, cross-functional initiatives across Information Security, partnering heavily with Engineering, Legal, Product and IT.

This role will coordinate execution across the Information Security portfolio by maintaining integrated program plans and operating cadences, tracking dependencies and commitments, surfacing risks and decisions, and providing leaders with clear visibility into progress. The portfolio includes initiatives spanning identity and access management, vulnerability management, infrastructure and product security, data protection, compliance, incident readiness, and secure software delivery.

Success in this role requires strong technical fluency and disciplined execution. You will bring structure to ambiguous challenges, build alignment across organizational boundaries, and exercise sound judgment to strengthen trust, governance, and security throughout Alteryx’s products and systems.

Primary Responsibilities

Build and maintain integrated program plans, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, decision points, ownership assignments, and success measures across the Information Security portfolio.
Coordinate complex initiatives spanning identity and access management, vulnerability management, infrastructure hardening, compliance and assurance, data protection, incident readiness, and secure software delivery.
Partner with accountable leaders across Information Security, IT, Infrastructure, Engineering, Product, Legal, and Privacy to maintain alignment and support effective execution.
Establish and manage operating cadences, including program reviews, working sessions, dependency reviews, decision tracking, and executive status reporting.
Track commitments, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers; ensure they are assigned to the appropriate owner and escalated with clear context, impact, and decision requirements.
Translate business, technical, security, and regulatory objectives into coordinated execution plans without displacing the accountability of functional or program owners.
Facilitate cross-functional decisions and trade-off discussions across scope, schedule, quality, resources, security, and customer impact. Document outcomes and ensure follow-through.
Develop dashboards, metrics, and concise reporting that provide working teams and senior leaders with visibility into progress, risk movement, delivery confidence, and areas requiring intervention.
Strengthen organizational memory by maintaining reliable records of decisions, actions, dependencies, ownership, and program status.
Improve program execution through scalable processes, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and continuous improvement practices.

Qualifications

8+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related field.
Proven success independently leading complex security, privacy, risk, compliance, or enterprise IT programs from strategy through delivery.
Expertise establishing program governance and operating mechanisms, including portfolio planning, OKRs, dependency and risk management, and executive reporting.
Excellent communication and influencing skills to drive alignment for technical teams, cross-functional partners, and senior leaders.
Strong analytical skills and experience using complex data and dashboards to guide prioritization, trade-offs, and program decisions.
Experience leveraging AI to improve engineering planning, execution, communication, and operational efficiency.

Valued Skills

Enterprise SaaS, AI platform, analytics platform, or cloud infrastructure experience.
Experience applying automation or AI solutions to improve planning, execution, reporting, communication, or operational efficiency; relevant program management, security, cloud, or agile certifications are a plus.
PMP, SAFe, Scrum, AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications.

Compensation

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

Company Description
Bourn Environmental is a Maryland-based firm that delivers ecological solutions through construction and land management services for public and private clients. As a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, the company focuses on stream restoration, stormwater management, shoreline stabilization, and wetland enhancement projects. Its work is centered in the Chesapeake Bay Watershed, supporting environmental resilience and regulatory compliance. Team members contribute to mission-driven projects that improve local ecosystems while partnering with municipalities, agencies, and private organizations. Bourn Environmental offers opportunities to work on complex environmental projects with a field-focused, collaborative culture.
Role Description
The Project Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bowie, MD, responsible for overseeing ecological construction and land management projects from planning through completion. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating project schedules, managing resources and subcontractors, and monitoring progress to ensure work is delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with environmental and safety regulations. The role involves working closely with clients, field crews, and internal stakeholders to clarify project requirements, address issues, and provide regular status updates. The Project Manager will review project documents, support permitting and inspections, track logistics for materials and equipment, and maintain accurate records and reports. This position also requires active participation at project sites to verify work quality, support field operations, and help resolve technical and logistical challenges.

Project management skills, including Project Management and Logistics Management, with experience coordinating schedules, resources, and budgets.
Expediting-related skills, such as Expeditor and Expediting, to ensure timely delivery of materials, permits, and documentation.
Inspection experience, with the ability to perform or coordinate Inspection activities to verify compliance with environmental, safety, and quality standards.
Knowledge of construction or environmental project workflows, preferably in stream restoration, stormwater management, shoreline stabilization, or wetland projects.
Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with field teams, clients, and regulatory agencies.
Proficiency in basic project management tools and software for scheduling, documentation, and reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Ability to work on-site in Bowie, MD, and at regional project locations, including outdoor field environments.

Amazon’s EU ATS Amazon Managed Planning Team develop and implement scalable solutions for Amazon to manage it's middle mile network. Our team's goal is to ensure highest accuracy of Amazon Managed loads, maximize the planning efficiency and Linehaul savings. The team plans capacity for the entire EU network and UK, that require building scalable cost-optimal solutions that work for entire network. As a Planner for Amazon Managed supply you will work on improving existing processes and solutions and challenge the status quo. This will require diving deep into performance data, understanding planning processes on a broader scale and working with multiple teams across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Program teams and everything in between.

Your responsibilities will include running and improving short- and mid-term planning processes for Amazon-managed supply during BAU, with a particular focus on high-volume events. In this role, you will stay close to operational processes and use this knowledge to lead programs that deliver end-to-end impact across Amazon’s supply mix by optimizing capacity, reducing costs, and anticipating and mitigating risks.

The Amazon Managed Planner requires good analytical, communication, dive-deep and collaboration skills to deliver against the aforementioned responsibilities successfully. Also, the Planner requires the ability to create the trust by sustaining best practices in process and program implementation, ensuring all changes are fully aligned and visible to the impacted teams, and influence the large multitude of stakeholders across various cross-functional teams.

ATS Amazon Managed Planner role and responsibility consists of managing an existing Amazon Managed planning process with a defined roadmap, and delivering complex projects aligned with the planning team’s vision of quality, automation and scalability. The Planner streamlines existing processes and identifies solutions for internal customers. In this role, the Planner works on solving complex operational problems related to constraints, demand and supply.

Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient. We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

Job Description:

Job Summary:

Are you a strategic orchestrator who thrives in complex, global environments? We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join our Global Team Management and Inclusion (GTMI) team to lead high-impact initiatives that bridge the gap between complex business challenges and creative, scalable solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who needs a roadmap; this is a role for someone who builds them. You will act as a change agent, driving global programs from inception to delivery, exercising sound judgment, and maintaining autonomy to steer stakeholders toward successful outcomes without needing a "safety net."

Key Responsibilities:

You won’t just be maintaining programs; you will be evolving our organizational intelligence. You will serve as the primary architect and driver for several high-visibility pillars:

AI School Strategy & Governance: You will be at the forefront of our enterprise-wide AI transformation. This includes modernizing the AI School, scaling content, and launching targeted programs (including AI communication and the integration of our internal OptU site) to ensure our workforce remains ahead of the curve.
Global Udemy Rollout: You will act as the end-to-end program lead for the global deployment of Udemy Enterprise. This is a high-stakes initiative requiring you to synchronize stakeholders across multiple time zones and secure alignment from senior leadership on adoption strategies that drive real business value.
End-to-End New Hire Experience: As a core contributor to our global end-to-end new hire redesign (OnboardU), you will influence the future of how we bring talent into the company. You will ensure that learning priorities and GTMI standards are seamlessly woven into a world-class, global onboarding experience.
Portfolio Excellence & Innovation: You will own the evolution of our core training assets, partnering with cross-functional program managers to shape the soft-skill capabilities of our global organization.

What You’ll Own

Global Strategic Partnership: Consult with business leaders worldwide to prioritize and solve complex, variable-factor problems.
Executive Presence & Facilitation: You are the face of your programs. You will own meetings with senior leadership, facilitate high-stakes discussions, and drive consensus. We value your ability to manage expectations, provide clear, concise communication, and follow through with a rigor that requires minimal oversight.
Change Leadership: As a catalyst for improvement, you will proactively identify issues, perform root-cause analyses, and implement solutions that evolve our business operations.

What You Bring

Proven Track Record: 8+ years of experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience). You have a history of navigating complex organizational structures and resolving issues that require more than a "textbook" approach.
Communication Mastery: You possess the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights for leadership. You know when to seek input from senior stakeholders and when to lead with confidence.
Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable working on issues where variables are constantly shifting, and you have the critical judgment to select the right techniques to achieve success.
Global Mindset: You understand that one size rarely fits all. You apply global nuances to your strategies, ensuring our programs are effective, inclusive, and scalable.
Continuous Improvement: You are proactively identifying opportunities to improve programs, processes and ways of working.
Measurement and Impact: You define success measures, evaluate effectiveness, and use data/insights to continuously improve outcomes.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree plus 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree plus 6 years
Demonstrated experience in instructional design, needs assessment, root cause analysis, and proactive stakeholder management.
A "Team Lead" mindset—you possess the capability to coordinate personnel and influence outcomes without relying on next-level management for daily direction.
Knowledge and experience in implementing AI training and global deployment of Udemy/online training is a plus.

jobs.description:

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

As a member of the KWI team you will receive

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Our commitment to you

At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

Our team works collaboratively across Product, Engineering, DevOps, Sales, and Support functions to ensure seamless customer implementations and exceptional service experiences.

We foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus. Team members are empowered to take ownership, solve complex challenges, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our delivery practices and customer engagement strategies.

About The Role

The Implementation Manager
serves as the primary point of contact for professional services engagements, leading customer implementations from planning through delivery. This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of customer projects and ensuring successful delivery against quality, scope, timeline, and budget objectives.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project and stakeholder manager who excels at coordinating cross-functional teams, building strong customer relationships, and driving projects to successful completion. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams, the Implementation Manager acts as the bridge between customers and technical teams, ensuring requirements are clearly understood, communicated, and delivered.

This position requires a highly organized and proactive professional who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a strong focus on client satisfaction and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Client Engagement

Manage a portfolio of client implementation projects, ensuring delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and timeline expectations.

Analyze client requirements and translate business needs into implementation plans and solution specifications.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with the Senior Implementation Manager to prioritize, plan, and monitor activities across Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams.

Facilitate alignment between technical and non-technical teams while managing expectations and project priorities.
Act as a liaison between customers and engineering teams, ensuring technical requirements are accurately communicated and understood.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Regularly communicate project status, performance metrics, delivery progress, and costs to clients and internal stakeholders.
Provide clear and concise updates to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Escalate risks, issues, and delivery challenges appropriately while driving resolution.
Collect and communicate customer feedback to Product teams to support future enhancements and roadmap planning.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

jobs.description:
Division: Weir Minerals

Location: Mexico (remote)

What We Do At Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact

As the T&A Project Manager for North America (NAM),
you will lead the implementation and successful delivery of Time & Attendance solutions across the region, ensuring project plans are effectively executed and key milestones are achieved.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role,
combining project governance with active involvement in project execution. Acting as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders, implementation partners, and program leadership, you will manage delivery activities, vendor performance, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness initiatives to ensure successful, compliant, and sustainable T&A deployments.

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Governance: Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, governance frameworks, and documentation, ensuring alignment with global program objectives, regional business needs, and implementation partner methodologies.
Project Delivery & Vendor Management: Lead end-to-end T&A implementations across North America, coordinating cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors to deliver all project phases, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, go-live, and transition to ongoing support.
Risk, RAIDD & Readiness Management: Manage RAIDD governance, proactively identifying risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies, while overseeing mitigation plans, stage-gate readiness assessments, operational preparedness, and go-live approvals across multiple countries and business units.
Change Management & Adoption: Partner with change, communications, and training teams to drive business readiness, user adoption, process standardization, and successful implementation of future-state workforce management processes, balancing global standards with regional operational and compliance requirements.
Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement: Provide project reporting and executive communications, including status updates, milestone tracking, project health indicators, resource and budget impacts, governance materials, and escalation of critical issues, while building strong relationships with business and leadership stakeholders.
Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

What You’ll Bring

Must-haves:

2 - 5 years leading Time & Attendance (T&A), Workforce Management (WFM), or Timekeeping system implementations
Experience delivering end-to-end projects across multiple countries, including vendor and implementation partner management.
Proficiency with workforce management platforms such as ADP eTime, ADP Essential, ADP EZ Labour, UKG, WorkForce Software, Dayforce, SAP SuccessFactors Time, Workday Time Tracking, or similar solutions.
Strong understanding of T&A processes, Payroll/HRIS integrations, RAIDD governance, project reporting, and executive stakeholder communication.
Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves:

Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent project management certification
Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery certifications
Experience supporting workforce management programs in North America, including knowledge of labor regulations, workforce scheduling, and timekeeping compliance across multiple countries.
Experience working in global transformation initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Collaboration with global teams

As a top-10 engineering school with the No. 1 program in Texas, the Cockrell School of Engineering at The University of Texas at Austin has been a global leader in technology innovation and engineering education for over a century. With 11 undergraduate and 13 graduate programs, over 20 research centers and a faculty community that boasts one of the highest number of National Academy of Engineering members among U.S. universities, Texas Engineering has launched some of the nation’s most accomplished leaders and pioneered world-changing solutions in virtually every industry, from space exploration to energy to health care. Situated in the heart of Austin — named “America’s Coolest City” by Expedia and “The Best Place to Live in the U.S.” by U.S. News and World Report — the Cockrell School embodies the city’s innovative spirit. Major companies with Austin campuses, such as Dell, National Instruments, Apple, IBM, Samsung, Google and many others, continue to recruit Cockrell School students at a remarkable rate, launching thousands of successful careers and developing Texas Engineers into industry leaders.

The Construction Industry Institute (CII) is a leading research unit at the University of Texas at Austin. For over 40 years, CII has brought together academics and industry volunteers from its 100+ member organizations to improve the management of capital projects through applied research that drives innovation and excellence in the construction industry. UT Austin provides outstanding employee benefits and total rewards packages that include:

Competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
Voluntary Vision, Dental, Life, and Disability insurance options
Generous paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
Teachers Retirement System of Texas, a defined benefit retirement plan, with 7.75% employer matching funds

Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional conference opportunities
Tuition assistance
An expansive employee discount program, including athletic tickets
Free access to UT Austin's libraries and museums with staff ID card
Free rides on all UT Shuttle and Austin CapMetro buses with staff ID card

Purpose

The CII Research Project Manager will coordinate the research portfolio, manage project information and reporting systems, and support multiple research initiatives. The position will collaborate with leading academic and industry professionals, use Power BI and Salesforce to develop dashboards and reports, and translate data into actionable insights. This role supports high-impact research that is presented at CII events, published for industry use, and applied to improve construction practices worldwide.

Responsibilities

Research Portfolio Management

Serve as the primary resource for information related to CII’s research portfolio, including project status, schedules, activities, participation, and outcomes
Manage portfolio-level research activities, records, systems, and reporting to support planning and organizational decision-making
Maintain the master research calendar, coordinating research team activities, committee meetings, project milestones, deliverables, and related events
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools to provide visibility into research projects, portfolio activity, and member engagement
Administer research data within Salesforce and other designated systems, including research team records, idea repositories, team rosters, attendance, project information, and related documentation
Develop and maintain research workflows, process documentation, and RACI matrices to define roles, responsibilities, approvals, and project requirements
Coordinate the preparation, publication, and distribution of research information through CII webpages, wikis, email communications, eblasts, and other communication channels
Manage the research ideation process used to identify and evaluate future research and development topics, including surveys, workshops, planning meetings, and member engagement activities

Research Team Management

Manage and monitor research team activities throughout the project lifecycle, including project initiation, progress tracking, deliverable review, presentation preparation, and project closeout
Track research objectives, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and action items, and provide status information to appropriate stakeholders
Manage the annual Request for Qualifications process, including solicitation, submission tracking, evaluation coordination, selection documentation, and applicant communications
Manage the annual Request for Nominations process, including member outreach, nomination tracking, deadline coordination, documentation, and reporting
Coordinate research team kickoff meetings and related launch activities in collaboration with CII events staff and research leadership
Maintain research team records, project documentation, meeting materials, and decision histories

Research Committee Support

Coordinate the operational activities of the Research Committee in consultation with committee leadership and the Director of Research
Plan and organize Research Committee meetings, including schedules, agendas, presentation materials, supporting documentation, and meeting logistics
Prepare draft slides, agendas, reports, briefing materials, and other documents for committee review and use
Document committee decisions, directives, action items, and follow-up requirements
Coordinate implementation of Research Committee decisions across the research portfolio and individual research projects
Facilitate communication between the Research Committee, research teams, CII staff, academic partners, and other stakeholders
Translate committee direction into operational plans, project activities, timelines, and deliverable requirements

Budget Management

Coordinate development and administration of the research budget in collaboration with the Director of Research and CII Financial Services staff
Prepare preliminary budget drafts, expenditure reports, cost projections, and other financial information based on current and anticipated research activities
Maintain historical records of research project costs, expenditures, commitments, and funding activity
Track and reconcile research expenditures against approved budgets and financial records
Monitor anticipated project costs and provide financial information to support budget forecasting and planning
Prepare routine and ad hoc budget reports for research leadership and CII Financial Services staff

Contract Oversight

Coordinate the initiation, review, routing, execution, and completion of research-related contracts and agreements
Serve as a liaison between research staff, academic partners, CII Financial Services staff, and other stakeholders during the contracting process
Track contract documentation, approvals, deadlines, status, and outstanding actions
Maintain contract records and communicate status updates to appropriate stakeholders
Coordinate contract and payment activities in accordance with applicable CII and University of Texas policies and procedures
Review contracting and payment processes and recommend improvements to research-related workflows

Academic and Research Program Support

Coordinate with CII events and communications staff to support academic programs, research presentations, student poster sessions, and researcher-industry engagement activities
Collect, organize, and provide research information needed for academic initiatives, meetings, publications, presentations, and events
Coordinate communications with academic partners, researchers, committee members, and other stakeholders
Manage the review and publication of academic and research content, including proofreading, formatting, routing, approval coordination, and publication
Coordinate research team quality assurance and quality control activities, including progress updates, issue tracking, deliverable reviews, revisions, and approvals
Track research deliverables and coordinate submission, review, revision, and completion requirements
Coordinate research team rehearsals and presentation preparation in collaboration with CII event managers
Support research lifecycle activities, including kickoff meetings, progress reviews, deliverable reviews, presentations, and project closeout

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
Five years of experience in project coordination, research administration, project management, or program management
Demonstrated experience with data management, business intelligence, reporting, and financial tracking
Proficiency in Power BI or a similar business intelligence tool for dashboard development and data visualization
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce for data management and reporting
Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and financial tracking
Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage deadlines and multiple complex projects
Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining accurate, current data
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and implement process improvements
Service-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate information to various stakeholders

Relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our flagship Sydney campus is uniquely Canva - an extension of our Surry Hills neighbourhood. It’s a thoughtfully designed space with plenty of room to collaborate, focus, and connect.

This role is based in Sydney, and we’re looking for someone who calls it home. Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration and connection when it matters most. We trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On

Leading planning based on company-wide processes: partnering with Engineering leads and Product Managers to support Strategic Planning and guiding Delivery Planning including scoping, prioritising, estimating and managing capacity.
Fully understanding the technical solution, being able to facilitate technical discussions with Engineering teams and help identify and close gaps.
Leading the delivery of large cross functional programs of work with high organisational complexity.
Managing technical dependencies across Groups and Supergroups: monitoring requirements for cross-functional work and facilitating dependency discussions.
Driving delivery and unblock teams to deliver outcomes in a timely manner: managing risks and issues, escalating them as needed, and driving timely decision-making.
Tracking and reporting on the progress of programs and projects: defining required processes for tracking delivery status and running regular cadences to manage delivery.
Leading Delivery processes as needed to promote excellence, increasing velocity and improving cross-collaboration: being an expert on delivery tools, exploring new methodologies, building dashboards and roadmaps, and upholding reporting standards.
Building a strong and trusted relationship with the leadership and Engineering teams: this is crucial for effective leadership, influencing strategic decisions and identifying areas for improvement in delivery.
Holding everyone accountable to their roles & responsibilities ensuring success as a team: this emphasises the TPM's role in ensuring clarity and adherence to responsibilities.
Facilitating continual improvement rituals to build the effectiveness of product development and engineering teams

You're probably a match if

You bring a minimum of 7 years of delivery experience in a SaaS environment, this role is very hands on.
You can demostrate experience shipping complex, multi-stakeholder programs that scale — ideally products or platforms used daily by hundreds or thousands of engineers.
Proven ability to lead programs where scope is evolving rapidly — AI technology shifts faster than traditional infrastructure, requiring continuous re-evaluation of approach and vendor strategy.
You excel at managing technical dependencies, navigating ambiguity and unblocking teams, proactively identifying and resolving risks, issues, and cross-team challenges to drive timely outcomes.
Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle at scale, CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, and what it takes to build for technical users.
Experience with developer productivity tooling: code review automation, IDE integrations, CLI tools, and cloud-based dev environments i.e Devboxes etc
Deep empathy for the developer audience; can put themselves in engineers' shoes and understand what drives adoption vs. resistance of new tools and workflows.
You lead with clarity and influence, using your exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to build strong relationships and keep teams aligned.
You consistently identify opportunities to improve processes and foster better cross-functional collaboration, helping teams deliver more effectively together.

Have At Least One Of These

A user of AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, or similar. Should have strong, experience-informed opinions on what works and what doesn't in enterprise engineering contexts.
Familiarity with agentic AI patterns; multi-agent orchestration, workflow chaining, and autonomous task execution i.e Coder Tasks running in production Devboxes, Otter workflow bundles etc
Direct experience building or leading AI-focused engineering tooling, or AI in platform/infrastructure contexts.

About The Infrastructure Supergroup

At Canva, the Infrastructure Group's focus is to make infrastructure easy for all the other engineering teams at Canva. We accomplish this by optimising existing solutions, developing internal tooling, promoting best practices throughout the organisation, introducing global infrastructure changes, and mentoring the engineering teams on how to do infrastructure - the right way. We work as a team to find pragmatic solutions to a wide range of performance and scaling problems to ensure Canva continues to grow and our users have smooth and seamless design experiences. The DevX Group is part of Canva's Platform org, sitting within the Infrastructure supergroup. Our mission is to empower every engineer at Canva to build and ship software with speed, confidence, and quality. We own the platforms, tools, and processes that form the backbone of the engineering development lifecycle — from writing and building code to testing and releasing it. We provide the foundational infrastructure for build systems and code collaboration, enabling efficient and secure software development. We focus on creating a frictionless development journey by streamlining workflows, building and enhancing tooling, and defining standards across engineering.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

ServiceNow's APEX (AI, Product, Engineering, and Experience) org is the largest organization in the company, comprised of all Products and Platform teams, along with our world class Design teams. We are leveraging the unlimited potential of our platform across every industry, geography, solutions, and personas to consistently deliver product and platform experiences our customers love. APEX is where ServiceNow's most critical innovations are conceived, built, and scaled — and where the programs you lead directly shape the trajectory of the company.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to join our APEX Strategic Programs organization. In this role, you will drive ServiceNow's most critical cross-functional priorities and strategic programs— operating at the intersection of strategy and execution and setting the standard for how high-impact programs are designed, governed, and run at scale.

This person will operate as an AI-native leader, using AI tools to accelerate program delivery, synthesize intelligence across workstreams and model the ways of working we expect to scale across APEX. In addition, the candidate is a result-oriented self-starter with extensive competence and experience in the Technical Program Management space. This candidate thinks strategically but loves getting into the details and possesses a strong ability to conceptualize, develop, drive, coordinate and manage large, complex, cross-functional programs supporting formal company Objectives and Key Results (OKRs). This person is effective at building relationships, collaborating, and influencing others; they must also be highly experienced working with senior executives across various geographies and functions.

Strategic Program Management Responsibilities

Operate as an AI-native program manager — using AI to synthesize intelligence across workstreams, surface risk signals, ensure data informs decision-making, draft and tailor communications at speed, direct AI agents, and provide leadership with actionable, forward-looking intelligence

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM)
jobs.description:
About Orbital Operations

Orbital Operations builds high-thrust, space-resident vehicles for defense and logistics. Space today lacks mobility. Satellites maneuver slowly and with limited range, while adversaries already operate dynamically on orbit, and U.S. response time is measured in months when it needs to be hours. That is a mobility problem, and we are solving it with Astraeus, a reusable, high-thrust orbital vehicle that brings launch-vehicle-class maneuver into orbit.

Astraeus is powered by Typhon, our LH2/LOx engine, and enabled by Boreas, our proprietary cryogenic propellant management system that eliminates boil-off through low-loss cryogenic storage, reverse Brayton cycle thermal control, and turbomachinery-driven propulsion. The result is long-duration storage and use of cryogenic propellants in space for the first time, delivering 100x higher thrust and 10x greater range than existing systems and making sustained, high-energy maneuver viable in geosynchronous and cislunar orbits.

Astraeus is a platform, not a point solution. By separating maneuver from payload, it becomes a reusable host for interceptors, sensors, and logistics, a new class of space-resident infrastructure that repositions, deploys, and responds on demand. Beyond defense, the same capability transforms commercial orbital logistics, cutting LEO-to-GEO transit times from six months to as little as eight hours and unlocking satellite servicing and deployment at a pace the industry has never had. Join us in building the infrastructure for a maneuverable, mission-ready space domain.

About The Role

We just won the contracts. Now we have to deliver them, and you are the person who makes that happen. As our first Technical Program Manager, you personally own execution of our funded government programs from kickoff through delivery. Cost, schedule, risk, and every deliverable the government is owed runs through you.

You are our first dedicated program manager, which means there is no process to inherit and real room to leave your mark. You will build the scheduling, risk, and reporting infrastructure that our program management function grows from, embedded in the team and working shoulder to shoulder with our engineers, mission operations, and leadership every day, translating between the technical work and the programmatic commitments. The templates and cadences you establish become the company standard, and strong performance in this seat puts you first in line to lead the function as it grows.

The role is technical on purpose. Our programs commit us to real engineering outcomes on a cryogenic orbital vehicle, and tracking milestones without understanding what is inside them does not work here. You will sit in design reviews, follow the technical tradeoffs, and be credible in the room with both our engineers and the customer's technical staff. To be clear on the seam, our engineers author the technical work and own the technical decisions. Your job is to be proficient enough to collaborate closely with them, synthesize their findings into program-level status the customer can act on, and connect the technical picture to cost, schedule, and risk.

Responsibilities

Program execution. Day-to-day management of our funded programs, including the integrated master schedule, milestone and deliverable tracking, action item management, and program battle rhythm. You drive every deliverable to on-time submission.
Government deliverables and reporting. The full deliverable package our customers are owed, including CDRLs, milestone review packages, status reports, and financial reporting inputs, with technical report content authored by engineering and compiled and delivered by you. Our contracts carry growth potential well beyond the funded base, and a clean deliverable record is what unlocks it.
Risk management. Build and maintain the program risk matrix, drive mitigation before risks become slips, and make sure leadership hears about problems while they are still cheap to fix.
Requirements and verification tracking. Partner with our engineers to keep contract requirements, verification status, and ICDs organized and current. Engineering owns the requirements content and verification approach, you own that the traceability from contract commitment to verified artifact is tracked, visible, and never surprises the customer.
Design review coordination. Manage the design review cadence (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) from the program seat, including scheduling, entrance and exit criteria tracking, action item closure, and customer sign-off. Engineering authors the review content and presents the technical work, you keep the process on track, unblock whatever engineering or the customer needs on the schedule and hardware front, and make sure reviews happen on time and land well.
Technical performance visibility. Work with our systems engineering and vehicle leads, who own the mass, power, and propellant budgets, to keep technical margin status visible alongside cost and schedule, and flag margin erosion early with its program impact quantified so tradeoffs get made deliberately.
Customer interface. Serve as the day-to-day point of contact with government program managers, CORs, and contracting officers on active contracts, and hold your own with their technical staff.
Cross-functional coordination. Keep engineering, mission operations, and supply chain aligned to contract milestones, and surface resource conflicts before they become schedule problems.
Process buildout. Create the WBS structures, scheduling discipline, risk registers, and reporting templates that become the company's program management foundation.
Proposal support. Support cost volumes, basis of estimates, and execution plans for new pursuits with realistic schedules and technical execution detail.

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years managing technical program execution on aerospace or defense programs, with hands-on ownership of schedules, deliverables, and risk, not just support roles on someone else's program
Demonstrated fluency with the core programmatic toolkit, including integrated master schedules, milestone and deliverable tracking, risk matrices, and milestone-based cost tracking. You will be asked to walk through artifacts you personally built and maintained
A proven history working on technical problems and managing hardware-focused technical programs, with the ability to follow system-level tradeoffs and engage credibly in design reviews. A technical degree is a bonus, demonstrated technical fluency is the requirement
Experience with government customers, ideally DoD, including deliverable management and direct interaction with program offices and contracting officers
Familiarity with OTs, SBIR/STTR, or other non-traditional contract vehicles is a strong plus
Comfort operating without an existing process, since you will be building the process
Experience with ITAR/EAR environments and eligibility to obtain a security clearance

What Success Looks Like

Base period milestones on our funded programs delivered on time and on budget, with a deliverable record clean enough that the government expands the work with confidence
Follow-on phases and contract growth secured on the strength of clean execution
A program management foundation, including schedules, risk registers, and review cadences, that would survive a customer program review and that new hires can be onboarded into
Government customers who know exactly where their program stands at all times

jobs.title: AI Project Manager

Job Description

ECS is seeking an AI Project Manager
to work in our Arlington, VA
office.

jobs.title: Regional Safety & Security Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As Anthropic scales across the Americas, the Regional Safety & Security Manager (RSSM), Americas is the single operational owner of safety and security execution for every Anthropic location in the region. Our global function leaders set the standards — for physical security design, enterprise risk, and environmental health & safety. The RSSM is the leader who employs those standards in the field: directing the campus security managers, the regional systems integration team, the safety practitioners, and the contract guard force that protect our people, facilities, and research every day.

This is a senior leadership role with real ownership. You own the region’s safety and security posture, its people, and its budget, and you are accountable for outcomes at every site.

Responsibilities

Regional operations: Own end-to-end safety and security operations for all Americas sites, protecting employees, visitors, assets, and AI research while maintaining ASL compliance.
Team leadership: Lead the region’s safety and security team — campus security managers, the Americas systems integration team, EH&S regional staff, and contracted guard-force partners. Set direction, develop talent, and manage performance.
Incident command: Serve as regional incident commander for critical incidents and emergencies; build and exercise emergency-response plans with local law enforcement and emergency services.
Standards execution: Implement and localize the global standards set by the Physical Security Design, Enterprise Risk, and EH&S global function leaders — consistently across the region, adapted to site and jurisdiction — and feed field intelligence back to keep standards sharp.
Budget and vendors: Own the regional safety and security budget and vendor portfolio; drive cost-effective coverage, guard-post standards, and service quality.
New sites: Collaborate with new-site leadership teams on security risk assessments, security design input, and pre-opening readiness, supporting the transition to steady-state operations.
Partnerships: Build trusted relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, and government partners across the region; represent Anthropic in regional public-safety forums.
Culture: Champion an approachable safety and security culture that enables — rather than restricts — a fast-moving research organization.

You may be a good fit if you

Have 10+ years of progressive safety and/or security leadership, including multi-site or regional responsibility and direct people leadership.
Have led sizable teams (staff and vendor/guard forces) of 50 or more and owned meaningful operating budgets in excess of $10M.
Have served as incident commander for complex, high-stakes incidents and built emergency-response capability.
Have delivered the security scope for complex capital facility projects — a new buildout or major renovation — from design through activation.
Have built durable partnerships with law enforcement, emergency services, and government agencies.
Communicate credibly with executives and front-line staff alike, and can influence across a matrixed organization without relying on direct authority.
Are willing to travel regularly across Americas sites and support a 24/7 on-call posture.

Strong candidates may have

A public-safety, law-enforcement, or military command background successfully transitioned into corporate security leadership.
Experience managing large teams of 100 or more and multimillion-dollar budgets ($25M and up) across multiple disciplines — safety programs, security technology teams, dispatch function, training and compliance.
Direct delivery of a capital security/facility project (e.g., a new operations center or campus) from design through opening.
A track record building critical-incident and workplace-violence-prevention programs.
Certifications such as CPP or PSP; ICS/FEMA incident-command training; active ASIS/InfraGard engagement.
A bachelor’s degree (master’s preferred) in a relevant field.
Experience in high-profile technology, research, or otherwise regulated environments.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$280,000—$340,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.description:
Verra Mobility is a global technology company supporting safer, smarter and more connected mobility. In Australia, our Government Solutions business delivers technology, software and operational services that support road safety programs.

We are seeking a Project Manager
to coordinate the delivery of software and technology projects
across company Operations. The role works with software engineering, product, operations, account management and customer stakeholders to manage project plans, delivery tracking, release coordination, risks, dependencies and project communication.

Prior experience in working with external Government stakeholders would be highly regarded.

A full time, hybrid, and permanent role working from home and South Melbourne.

What you'll do:

Coordinate assigned software and technology projects from planning through to delivery.
Maintain project plans, status reports, RAID logs, action registers and dashboards.
Work with software engineering, product, operations and customer-facing teams to keep delivery on track.
Support release planning, deployment readiness and post-release follow-up.
Track risks, issues, actions and dependencies, escalating early where required.
Support customer communication, scope control and project financial tracking.

What you'll bring

5+ years' experience in project coordination or project management, ideally in software, IT or technology (incl Hardware) delivery.
Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Kanban or hybrid delivery approaches.
Experience using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or similar.
Understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing, release and change control.
Strong stakeholder communication, meeting facilitation, problem-solving and escalation judgement.
Ability to work effectively with software engineers, testers, product owners, operations teams and customer-facing stakeholders.
Exposure to enterprise software, APIs, databases, cloud platforms or regulated technology environments would be advantageous.

Qualifications

A tertiary qualification in information technology, software engineering, business, project management or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent practical experience in software or technology project delivery will also be considered.
Project management certification such as Agile, Scrum, PRINCE2, PMI is not essential.

Apply now
