Koniag Operations Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Project Manager with a Top-Secret security clearance to support KOS and our government customer in Williamsburg, KY. This position is for a Future New Business Opportunity.

We offer competitive compensation and an extraordinary benefits package including health, dental and vision insurance, 401K with company matching, flexible spending accounts, paid holidays, three weeks paid time off, and more.

Koniag Operations Services, a Koniag Government Services company, is looking for a highly qualified, experienced and self-motivated individual to perform the duties of a Project Manager with a Top-Secret clearance for a large government facilities complex in Williamsburg, KY.

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing the completion of task order Operations and Maintenance/Custodial efforts from start to finish, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and according to the defined scope, by managing resources, coordinating teams, identifying risks, and communicating effectively with stakeholders throughout the contract lifecycle.

Essential Functions, Responsibilities & Duties may include, but are not limited to:

Plans and coordinates priority projects and initiatives per the contract scope of work and as assigned by the Program Manager.
Responsible for effectively managing and leading a team of employees comprised of various Maintenance Personnel, Production Control Clerk, Mechanics, and Custodians to deliver contractual requirements.
Reviews, tracks, and closes out all preventive maintenance and corrective action work orders to ensure they are completed in a timely manner per the contract requirements.
Ensure the safe and efficient management and delivery of maintenance & operations activities including emergency response and winter operations through the supervisors and team leaders
Tracks the monitoring of emergency back-up and building safety support systems, including Fire Alarm, sprinkler, and suppression systems.
Oversee custodial operation to ensure that all custodial contractual requirements and deliverables are met.
Ensure employees have appropriate equipment and resources to perform their jobs and meet goals/ deadlines
Coordinate all service and maintenance contracts.
Mitigate discrepancies in requirements directly with customer.
Directs and supervises all support resources for the performance of project assignments and activities.
Assists in the development and implementation of program policies, processes, procedures and monitoring the achievement of program objectives/deliverables.
Responsible for all aspects of the development and implementation of assigned projects and provides a single point of contact for those projects.
Responsible for coordination with vendors providing service for the contract
Coordinates efforts with various program departments, to include Operations, Finance, and corporate support teams including Recruiting and Procurement.
Researches and analyzes operational, financial, and administrative data to assist in the cost efficient, effective projects.
Must have ability to execute Reimbursable Work Authorizations (RWAs) per Government standards.
Develops detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports for RWAs.
Collects and analyzes information and prepares reports regarding program metrics and operational activities.
Prepares and approves Standard Operating Procedures, Protocols and other technical documentation.
Ensures adherence to quality standards and reviews project deliverables.
Provides management services including general administrative oversight, time accounting, inventory management, personnel evaluation, support, and hiring of personnel.
Manage and perform quality control inspections.
Other duties as assigned by the Program Manager

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree 5 years of project management experience or 10 years of project management experience in lieu of the degree.
Project Management of Federal Government contracts are preferred.
Demonstrated skill and comfort in proactively building relationships.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management.

Active Top-Secret clearance required.

We are the Philippines' #1 Online Gift Store, on a mission to make gifting thoughtful, affordable, and convenient across Southeast Asia. Backed by international investors, we are a dynamic and fast-growing e-commerce team looking for passionate individuals to join our journey.

We are looking for a Business Operations Manager
to lead strategic business initiatives and drive operational excellence across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and executing cross-functional projects, improving business processes, identifying operational efficiencies, and partnering with department leaders to align initiatives with the company's long-term goals and growth strategy.

The ideal candidate has experience in business operations, strategy, project management, management consulting, or process improvement, with strong analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills. They are passionate about optimizing business performance, leading organizational change, and collaborating across teams to implement scalable solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support sustainable business growth.

Responsibilities:

Manage the end-to-end planning, preparation, and execution of major campaigns, ensuring operational readiness across all departments.
Develop integrated campaign timelines, project plans, and execution roadmaps while coordinating deliverables across departments and other key stakeholders.
Develop and implement strategic frameworks, performance metrics, and governance processes to improve visibility, accountability, and cross-functional alignment.
Identify, evaluate, and implement cost optimization initiatives while maintaining operational efficiency and business performance.
Drive continuous process improvement by simplifying workflows, eliminating operational bottlenecks, and standardizing best practices across departments.
Lead strategic business projects and operational initiatives that support organizational growth, scalability, and continuous improvement.
Oversee the planning, execution, and successful delivery of cross-functional initiatives and special projects that improve organizational performance and support business objectives.
Collaborate with department heads to identify opportunities for operational excellence, process automation, and scalable business solutions.
Conduct post-campaign reviews by analyzing performance, documenting lessons learned, and implementing improvements for future initiatives.
Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment, effective communication, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Mentor and develop Business Operations team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in business operations, strategy, management consulting, project management, or a similar role, with at least 2 years in a leadership or managerial position.
Proven experience leading cross-functional projects and driving organizational or operational improvements.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
Excellent project management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across all levels of the organization.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel
Results-oriented, proactive, adaptable, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Experience in e-commerce, retail, technology, or a high-growth startup environment is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
The Cyber Threat Intelligence Unit

The CTI Unit is critical to understanding the threat landscape. Our responsibilities include:

 Directing and Planning: Guiding information collection based on the intelligence requirements of 
internal organizational units, clients, and other stakeholders.
 Knowledge Management: Maintaining and evolving a shared cyber knowledge base to support 
service delivery.
 Adversary Analysis: Analyzing the intent, motivation, and capabilities of cyber adversaries, and 
how they leverage the cyber domain to achieve their objectives.
 Operational Support: Supporting our Managed Security Services and Active Defense & 
Automation teams by correlating external intelligence data with internal telemetry, triaging 
indicators, and conducting Threat Hunting processes driven by Threat Intelligence insights.
 Guidance & Awareness: Providing actionable recommendations on security controls based on the 
current threat context (Threat Situational Awareness and Vulnerability Management).
Key Responsibilities
The CTI Analyst will be responsible for a range of activities, including:
 Intelligence Production: Contributing to the production of high-quality, English-language Threat 
Intelligence reports and briefings for clients and internal groups (e.g., CSIRT, RTSM, RED 
TEAM).
 Executive Reporting: Preparing concise context reports for management, distilling complex 
information into strategic insights.
 Alert Triage & Reporting: Monitoring and analyzing alerts from automated systems, producing 
relevant intelligence reports based on findings.
 Briefings & Presentations: Developing and presenting tactical, operational, and strategic reports 
and presentations in English.
 Client Engagement: Conducting briefings in English for CTI service clients.
 Geopolitical Monitoring: Proactively monitoring the geopolitical landscape and its correlation 
with cyber threats.
 Threat Actor Tracking: Tracking top-tier Threat Actors (TTPs, infrastructures, victims, etc.) to 
address specific Intelligence Requirements.
 Incident Support: Working closely with other security teams (e.g., Incident Response) during 
specific threats and vulnerabilities.
 Automation: Contributing to the automation of CTI tradecraft and processes to enhance 
intelligence production efficiency.
 Malware Analysis Support: Interpreting the results of malware analysis tools and escalating to the 
dedicated malware analysis/reverse engineering team when necessary.

Company Internal Required Qualifications

Experience Level

 At least 3 years of documented experience in CTI Education
 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent 
(Specialization in Cyber Security is a plus).
 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in International Relations (with demonstrable competence in Cyber 
Security).

Language Skills

 Excellent written and spoken English proficiency (B2 level or higher is mandatory).
Technical Knowledge & Skills
 Demonstrated experience in academic and/or scientific writing.
 Solid understanding of the contemporary and historical geopolitical scenario and context.
 Knowledge of the Intelligence Cycle and Intelligence Analysis methodologies.
 Applied knowledge of Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) techniques.
 Familiarity with foundational models: Diamond Model and the Cyber Kill Chain.
 Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
 Programming/Scripting skills, preferably Python is a plus.
 Experience with Python for data analysis (e.g., Pandas) is a plus.

Essential Behavioral Competencies

 Analytical & Synthesis Skills: Strong organizational autonomy and a keen orientation towards 
analysis and synthesis.
 Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving abilities and a capacity for "out-of-the-box" 
reasoning.
 Teamwork & Collaboration: Proven ability to operate effectively in a team environment.
 Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to facilitate effective communication with internal and 
external stakeholders, adhering to the escalation matrix during emergencies or incidents.
 Resilience: Demonstrated ability to manage stress effectively.
 Results-Oriented: A strong focus on achieving measurable results.

Other Requirements

 Travel: Availability for short-term domestic and international travel.
 Salary Range: RM4,000 – RM6,000

Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

As a member of Procurement Operations, partner with managers and suppliers as the point of contact and subject matter expert on the SAP Ariba platform, including contract management, governance, audits, onboarding and training.

Responsibilities:

Serve as a contact for SAP Ariba inquiries from procurement leads,, suppliers, and US based & global business groups.
Ensure creation of contract workspaces are properly integrated from CLM into SAP Ariba for accurate loading and maintenance of contracts in accordance with governance framework.
Manage audit requests, policy attestation, and internal procurement policy and process documentation.
Provide SAP Ariba training sessions to new users.
Update and maintain Procurement SharePoint and related systems with document revisions and procedural changes as needed.
Research and resolve invoicing questions/issues and partner with Accounts Payable to remediate unpaid invoices, contract variances, accounting errors, etc.
Provide guidance on pricing terms, budget, expirations, and generate reports using SAP Ariba, CLM and Omniflow as needed.
Research and resolve supplier issues and answer questions regarding SAP Ariba life cycle/CLM and performance (SLP), Accounts Payable, registrations, and invoicing mismatches.
Provide transition support for exiting supplier relationships.
Analyze procurement spend trends using data derived from various systems.
Identify and implement process and workflow improvements to increase efficiency, compliance, and data accuracy.
Serve as a flexible, cross-functional partner, supporting procurement operations and systems needs as priorities evolve.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in a business field or equivalent experience
Three years of relevant experience with in-depth knowledge of the SAP Ariba platform
Procurement experience including contract administration
Excellent written/oral communication and interpersonal skills
Customer focused
Technical aptitude to quickly navigate systems

1+ years of relevant experience with in-depth knowledge of a CLM platform (e.g. Sirion, Icertis, etc.)
Self-starter and a strong team-oriented mindset, collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners and contributing to a positive and high-performing team environment

Hybrid office environment: 3 days in office (Baltimore/Denver/Cedar Rapids/Philadelphia)

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $61,000 - $81,000 annually. Position Summary

This role leads the operational execution and data integrity efforts across ERP systems within the Clutches & Brakes (C&B) Division of the Industrial Powertrain Solutions (IPS) Sector. The position is responsible for ensuring accurate sales and purchase order processing, maintaining master data consistency, and resolving pricing discrepancies. It also serves as a key liaison between the Milwaukee HQ and plant operations, driving alignment on priorities and system readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Order Management & Correction
Review and correct sales orders and purchase orders to ensure alignment with customer requirements and internal controls.
Address discrepancies in billing, buyer codes, and PO email routing as needed between ERP systems
Help operations transfer inventory electronically
Maintain Pricing in all 3 sales organizations

SAP Master Data Management
Create and maintain Purchase Info Records (PIR) and Source Lists using SAP ERP systems
Ensure material master data is accurate and synchronized across multiple SAP environments (e.g., Altra PRD, RRX SAP)

EDI Pricing Error Resolution
Utilize SAP transactions to identify and correct EDI pricing errors, ensuring accurate pricing transmission and order processing

Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate with Plant Operation teams to align priorities, resolve system issues, and support cutover activities for SAP deployments
Participate in meetings and communications with planners, buyers, and IT ERP leads to ensure smooth operations and data integrity

System Access & Role Mapping
Support SAP role provisioning and access setup for business users across CUU2 and El Paso plants

Process Improvement & Compliance
Identify and implement process improvements to enhance order accuracy and reduce pricing errors.
Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, including ITAR and proprietary data handling

Leadership & Strategy
Contribute to commercial operations strategy by providing insights from order trends, system performance, and plant feedback.
Support talent development and cross-functional collaboration across planning, customer care, and IT teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related technical field.
5+ years of experience in SAP operations, order management, and commercial operations.
Experience with master data governance and EDI troubleshooting.
Ability to work cross-functionally with supply planning, IT, and commercial teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Prior experience in manufacturing or industrial operations preferred.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities

$81,900-$92,900

Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, the geographic market of that location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education and internal peer compensation comparisons among other potential factors.

Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
Paid Time Off and Holidays
401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
Paid Leaves

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

jobs.title: Sr Professional, Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Cotality, we are driven by a single mission—to make the property industry faster, smarter, and more people-centric. Cotality is the trusted source for property intelligence, with unmatched precision, depth, breadth, and insights across the entire ecosystem. Our talented team of 5,000 employees globally uses our network, scale, connectivity and technology to drive the largest asset class in the world. Join us as we work toward our vision of fueling a thriving global property ecosystem and a more resilient society.

Cotality is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive work culture that inspires innovation and bold thinking; it's a place where you can collaborate, feel valued, develop skills and directly impact the real estate economy. We know our people are our greatest asset. At Cotality, you can be yourself, lift people up and make an impact. By putting clients first and continuously innovating, we're working together to set the pace for unlocking new possibilities that better serve the property industry.

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Professional Business Analyst to lead end-to-end, cross-functional process optimization initiatives. In this role, you will analyze complex workflows, apply lean/re-engineering methodologies, design metrics, and facilitate change to drive operational excellence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Process Optimization & Execution: Independently scope, plan, and execute complex process improvement initiatives across diverse business functions.
Analysis & Problem Solving: Map and evaluate existing workflows, using root-cause analysis to pinpoint operational bottlenecks, performance shortfalls, and inefficiencies.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Assemble, facilitate, and lead multi-disciplinary project teams to deliver high-impact business solutions on time and within scope.
Data & Performance Measurement: Establish advanced operational metrics, KPI dashboards, and leading indicators to track process efficiency and drive continuous improvement.
Strategic Advisory: Consult with senior stakeholders on business process re-engineering (BPR) techniques to enhance quality, speed, and overall performance.
Reporting & Presentation: Develop analytical reports and present data-driven recommendations, control plans, and methodology frameworks to key stakeholders.
Mentorship & Mentoring: Guide, train, and coach junior Business Analysts in process methodologies, data tools, and problem-solving techniques.

Job Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field preferred
Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in business analysis, operations management, or process engineering.
Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in business analysis frameworks, process re-engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), and quantitative data analysis.
Project & Team Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and managing end-to-end improvement projects independently.
Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with a proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities with a data-first approach to diagnosing operational challenges.

Annual Pay Range

77,700 - 90,000 USD

Application Window

This opportunity is expected to remain posted through the date identified below, subject to business needs.

2026-08-17

At Cotality, we offer more than just a job, we provide a benefits experience designed to support your whole self. From a flexible working model to competitive time off and standout health coverage with meaningful perks and growth opportunities, our package is built to help you thrive at work and in life.

Highlights, Depending On Role Classification, Include

Time off: Generous PTO and 11 paid holidays, plus well-being and volunteer time off.
Family Support: Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave and a baby stipend.
Health: Multiple medical plan options with mental health and wellness support offerings.
Retirement: 401(k) with company match and vesting after one year.
Financial Perks: $400 annual well-being stipend and tuition assistance up to $5,250.
Extras: Recognition Rewards, Referral bonuses, exclusive discounts and more!

Cotality is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to attracting and retaining the best-qualified people available, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability or status as a veteran of the Armed Forces, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.   Responsible to execute processes of Sample Management and associated adhoc/project work. This includes understanding and representing the respective local market conditions in the operations processes, as well as executing defined country work. This entails engaging local and regional partners like Output and Input Operations.  

RESPONSIBILITIES

The person will execute, monitor, and continuously improve production tasks assigned to the Statistical Operations function as sample maintenance and data quality checks.  
Understand regular execution process with attention to detail and identify areas of automation and improvement
Execute processes of Statistical Operations and associated adhoc/project work. Execution work requires understanding of aspects of the universe, sample design, data queries and all related activities throughout the production process, potentially for different countries.  
Participate in development and drive standardization and process efficiency for method related process / application.    
Engage with cross functional teams (RE / Dsci / Output and Input Operations) to collect information and coordinate tasks to improve data quality and drive for continuous business process improvements.    
Prepare accurate tracking KPI to monitor and improve quality performances (on time delivery and data accuracy) and maintain adhoc/project work discipline.  
Operate in a virtual/multi-cultural environment, liaising with stakeholders and colleagues

Qualifications

Excellent organization skills, aptitude to work in a team and meet deadlines  
A high degree of accuracy, proactivity and attention to detail 
Minimum of 1 year relevant working experience

Adhoc/project management aptitude (critical path, task sequencing, problem solving, etc.)

MCIM is how critical facility operators make every data center stronger. With a purpose-built platform and real-time analytics, MCIM eliminates silos, removes blind spots, and ensures operators never go it alone in managing mission-critical infrastructure.

For too long, data centers have operated with fragmented tools, inconsistent workflows, and unreliable data, capping their potential. No silos — one platform that unites workflows across sites and teams

You have strong skills and intuition, combining and studying multiple sources of business data for interpretation and analysis

3+ years of Salesforce Analytics (i.e., Wave/Einstein Analytics/Tableau CRM) experience

Technical expertise regarding data models, database design, data visualizations (i.e., Tableau), and development

These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.  welocalize.com

Welocalize is seeking a Multilingual Data Annotation Project Manager for an initial 1-year contract to join our global localization delivery team. In this role, you will lead the execution, validation, and delivery of high-volume multilingual localization and quality assurance (LQA) projects for our enterprise clients. You will act as the key operational bridge between client-side teams, in-country linguistic reviewers, translation vendors, and internal talent communities to ensure multilingual assets are culturally aligned, linguistically flawless, and delivered on schedule. 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage end-to-end localization projects, including scope planning, resource allocation, schedule tracking, and final delivery of multilingual content.

Prepare comprehensive project briefs, handoff packages, linguistic quality guidelines, and progress trackers for global teams.

Coordinate and onboard in-country reviewers, freelance linguists, subject matter experts (SMEs), and translation vendors.

Partner with Quality Specialists to operationalize Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) frameworks, scorecards, error typologies, and evaluation rubrics.

Monitor project financials, budgets, and operational margins to ensure service delivery aligns with established KPIs.

Run quality checks, facilitate reviewer calibration sessions, and manage feedback loops to resolve linguistic differences and improve output consistency.

Support client relationship management by serving as a primary operational contact, proactively managing project risks, and quickly addressing delivery blockers.

Practical experience working with Translation Management Systems (TMS) and Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools (such as Smartling, Phrase, XTM, or Crowdin).

Strong capability in coordinating virtual, diverse teams of linguists and localization vendors across multiple global time zones.

Solid experience managing project budgets, scope-of-work changes, and financial tracking systems.

Experience utilizing bug-tracking and project management systems (such as Jira and Confluence) to track linguistic errors, validation feedback, and project tasks.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex operational requirements.

Exceptional organizational and problem-solving abilities, with a strong attention to detail.

High level of resilience and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities under tight turnaround times and budget constraints.

Strong interpersonal skills to build trust, resolve disputes, and maintain collaborative relationships with both external clients and global suppliers.

jobs.description:
About Epirus

Epirus is a high-growth technology company dedicated to overcoming the asymmetric challenges inherent to the future of national security. Epirus' flagship product, Leonidas, is a software-defined system built using intelligent power management techniques which allow power-hungry systems to do more with less.

Job Summary:
This is an exciting role in an innovative, high-growth defense technology company. Under an agile development framework, Technical Project Managers at Epirus serve as both scrum masters and product owners, leading research and development projects from initial planning through delivery of first-article solutions. Epirus products are typically developed ahead of customer involvement and requirements, so engineers rely on product owners, usually a TPM and a Chief Engineer, to understand both short-term priorities and long-term value to the end customer, whom they represent during the R&D phase. In this role, you will work closely with talented engineering and operations teams, reporting to the Manager of Technical Project Management within the Engineering and Technology Organization (ETO).

Responsibilities

Act as the bridge between ETO and other department stakeholders (e.g., marketing, sales, operations) for one or multiple efforts
Ensure that teams are aligned on goals and timelines that enable Epirus to build the best products possible
Create and own agile/hybrid project plans, including schedules, budgets, and other artifacts
Be a servant leader to an interdisciplinary and inter-functional scrum to ensure the team delivers the highest value to Epirus and its customers
Remove obstacles and find creative ways to do things better, faster, and more efficiently
Track the delivery of technical features, ensuring that milestones and deadlines are met. Report progress to relevant stakeholders
Identify potential risks, dependencies, and obstacles, and work proactively to resolve them before they impact the timeline or deliverables
Drive company goals by both delivering on company promises while also foreseeing future opportunities and shaping technology products to be more effective

Basic Qualifications

B.S. in Engineering or a related technical field AND minimum 2 years of relevant project management experience, especially in high-growth startups and aerospace 
Experience with the deployment and integration of hardware and software systems  
Experience with building, leading, and developing small teams of engineers  
Prior systems engineering or software integration experience 
Prior experience hosting and leading both technical and non-technical reviews with cross-functional audiences 
Prior experience building and managing project artifacts like schedules, budgets, and risk registers 

Preferred Skills And Experience

Previous experience using JIRA or other agile-enabling software platforms 
Proficient in MS Project and/or Smartsheet use 
Engineering or Operations leadership program graduate or related experience  
Previous work on DoD Projects 
Superior communication skills 
Collaborative; capable of working across all levels of the organization with limited resources  
Organized, comfortable setting, and achieving goals in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment   

Itar Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.  

At Epirus, you’ll work with technical peers and great people—and get first crack at some of the defining technology challenges of our time. Here, “impossible” is just a challenge. We're a diverse, fast-growing team of change-makers fueling the future of energy with revolutionary solutions. Join us and rewrite the rules.

jobs.title: Technical Publications Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
Team Overview
Anduril’s Technical Publications organization supports complex hardware, software, autonomy, and defense systems across multiple divisions, business lines, and programs. This role gives Technical Publications leadership the current, well-sourced information they need to manage requirements, deliverables, briefings, and follow-through across the department.
Role Specifics
As the Technical Publications Program Analyst, your mission is to keep Technical Publications leadership current, prepared, and able to make decisions without chasing information across the department. You will turn program requirements, contractual deliverables, leadership requests, and cross-functional inputs into clear trackers, briefing materials, and action records that leadership can trust and act on immediately. This role supports the day-to-day operation of the department: requirements tracking, CDRL and DMRL management, leadership briefings, cross-functional coordination, and the business-operations work that supports a growing team. The right candidate keeps the record current, drives open items to completion, and maintains accurate status without prompting.
What You’ll Do
Gather, reconcile, and track technical publication requirements across programs, contracts, standards, and customer deliverables.
Track CDRL, DMRL, and other committed deliverable schedules and keep leadership current on what is due and what has changed.
Build and maintain trackers, decision logs, action records, and status materials that leadership and the Operations Manager rely on.
Prepare briefings, status summaries, planning materials, and decision documents for leadership.
Coordinate cross-functional follow-through across Technical Publications, Mission Readiness, Engineering, Program Management, Training, ILS, Support, and Product.
Support leadership reviews, agendas, pre-reads, action tracking, proposals, and the administrative work that supports department operations.
Handle sensitive business and personnel information with discretion while keeping the record accurate and current.

Required Qualifications

Experience in program analysis, business operations, project coordination, technical operations, or a similar role in an environment with formal requirements or customer deliverables.
Strong written communication and presentation skills, including preparing materials for senior leadership.
Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail across multiple concurrent assignments.
Ability to maintain accurate trackers and status records that others can trust for decision-making.
Ability to reconcile conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders and turn them into a clear current record.
Experience maintaining milestone and deliverable discipline where Draft, Preliminary, and Final states materially change what is considered done.
Must be eligible for Secret and higher security clearance (US).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomy, software, hardware, or another complex technical environment.
Familiarity with CDRLs, DMRLs, formal documentation requirements, or similar deliverable tracking structures.
Experience supporting leadership staff work, operational planning, executive briefings, or program reviews.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration and work-tracking systems.
Familiarity with technical publications, Mission Readiness, ILS, training, or program-management workflows

US Salary Range
$112,000—$149,000 USD
Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:
At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.
Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.
By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Location - Santa Clara- Onsite

Your Career

As a Key Member Of The Technical Operations Team

You will be responsible for driving development and supporting the launch of X86 hardware appliances, primarily with global contract manufacturing.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams that include various development engineering teams (Electrical/Hardware, Mechanical, Compliance, Software, etc), operations teams (Test Engineering, Quality, Planning, Manufacturing Engineering, Component Engineering, Supply Base Management, Supply Chain Mgmt, etc.), and manufacturing partners.
The ideal candidate will be able to drive programs at both a tactical & strategic level and have a blend of technical expertise & business acumen.
Your efforts will result in cybersecurity products that provide industry-leading protection to our customers and outstanding business results for the company.

Your Impact

Subject Matter Expert in new product introduction for x86 hardware appliances
Collaborate on product development with cross-functional teams, including Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Product Management, Mechanical Engineering, Hardware Validation, Test Engineering, Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Mgmt, etc.
Create schedules for hardware development and prototyping that align with software development schedule(s) to ensure a smooth transition into system integration
Ensure that quality and reliability objectives are met through hardware validation, manufacturing test, and release management
Develop phase gate release criteria and enforce completion of hardware validation with buy-in from cross-functional team
Ensure Order Fulfillment readiness for all new SKUs and FRUs by collaborating with Business Systems, Planning, Supply Chain, Repair & Failure Analysis Engineering, Service Logistics, etc.
Facilitate the Design for Manufacturing (DFM) process with global contract manufacturer and printed circuit board fabrication.
Ensure the Design for Assembly (DFA) process meets objectives for cost, quality and speed.
Identify and mitigate risks through early engagement, bug tracking and cross-functional risk assessment.
Support the Test Engineering team in meeting Design for Test (DFT) objectives.
Facilitate Product Characterization and Component Characterization to derisk DFM issues and assembly defects.
Make recommendations for risk buys based on product architecture and lead time analysis.
Identify cost-reduction opportunities through the development of should cost model and multi-sourcing.
Drive ECO (Engineering Change Order) and implement corrective actions.
Establish Traceability on components to trace the history, location and genealogy through multi-level BOM tracking.
Continuously improve the hardware product lifecycle through retrospectives and best practices.
Lead Post Ramp Qualification (PRQ) process for technical initiatives such as Hard Tooling and Optical Transceivers.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members.

Your Experience

8+ Yrs Experience in product development and manufacturing environment.
Proven experience managing cross-functional teams in NPI program management of x86 hardware platforms.
Knowledge of Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA)
Strong knowledge of product development processes, including Hardware Validation, Product Characterization, Design for Test, Design for Manufacturing, and Design for Assembly
Familiar with Product Development tools such as Valor, Arena, Jira and CAD
Experience managing manufacturing processes and identifying cost-reduction opportunities
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously
Strong project management skills, including risk assessment and schedule management.
Experience with contract negotiations and commercial discussions
Excellent supplier and material management experience
Demonstrated entrepreneurial approach to Operations management in an ambiguous fast-paced environment handling multiple projects in parallel.

Education

Bachelor degree in an engineering discipline or equivalent experience.

Please note that the compensation information in this posting reflects the hourly wage only and does not include benefits. Magnit offers Medical, Dental, Vision and 401K. Position Overview

This role will be based in Nevada, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).

The Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment is responsible for managing the seamless transition of new data centers to Site Operations teams and ensuring Operational Readiness at Site Turnover from Construction. Requirements for this position include a strong understanding of data center facility operations, best practices, and site critical systems, combined with the ability to plan, track, and deliver multiple concurrent deployment projects on time and within defined operational quality standards.

This position is highly cross-functional, interfacing with peer teams in Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and Site Operations, requiring engagement at multiple levels of management throughout the company. This role demands both project management skill and technical acumen, as responsibilities include technical document reviews (e.g., Test and Balance (TAB) reports, commissioning documentation), verification of system performance, and ensuring operational standards are met prior to turnover.

This role is open on a rolling basis, and we review applications as they come in. There’s no set deadline, but if you’re interested, we encourage you to apply soon—our hiring needs can shift, and we welcome applications at any time while the opportunity is available.

Essential Job Functions

Act as a key point of contact coordinating Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and Site Operations teams to seamlessly transition new data centers to Site Operations.
Develop and manage detailed deployment project schedules, milestone tracking, and risk mitigation plans for site readiness activities.
Perform technical reviews of commissioning documentation, TAB reports, and other turnover deliverables to validate operational performance and compliance with design intent.
Manage the recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and training of new Operations teams at greenfield sites, contributing to the effective operational launch of these locations.
Ensure complete program-level Operations protocols, procedures, and standards are in place for newly built facilities to achieve Operational Readiness.
Ensure quality of Commissioning and Facility Acceptance necessary to deliver a technically sound facility to Site Operations.

Duties And Responsibilities

Maintain communication and collaborate with stakeholders during all phases of a new data center build.
Manage schedules and facilitate cross-team engagement keeping pace with Construction delivery dates.
Track project deliverables against defined timelines and escalate risks/issues with recommended mitigation strategies.
Ensure timely completion of Ops Site Deployment quality control checklists and Site Start-Up processes.
Compile Procedures (MOP, SOP, EOP Templates) for Site Start Up across all Sites in deployment and adapt MOP, SOP, EOP templates to Site Specifics.
Ensure the readiness of Operations Support spaces including Tool shop, Critical Spares storage spaces.
Ensure the site is safe to operate with Safety Protocols, Safety Equipment, and Signage in place.
Ensure Billing System Readiness and cross-functional contributions are fully coordinated.
Ensure Asset Management Systems are in place and Site Equipment is fully accounted for including Warranty and Spare Parts information.
Ensure CMMS is fully populated with equipment data and maintenance scheduling plans.
Ensure the Site Security Systems are fully deployed at Site Turnover.
Ensure Site Operators are fully trained and ready to operate and maintain critical systems.
Ensure Permits, Licenses, Agreements are in place to facilitate Operations.
Ensure 3rd party maintenance suppliers and contract agreements are set-up prior to Site Turnover.
Support site mobilization including procuring spares, tools, and consumables.
Lead formal technical review of O&M manuals, as-built & record drawings, permits, certificates, warranty documents, and commissioning reports prior to turnover.
Perform site walks and site turnover walks to ensure Operational Readiness requirements are met.
Share lessons learned that have been captured for consideration/mitigation in future builds.
Coordinate and facilitate the formal transfer of site responsibility from Construction to Operations.

Job Requirements

3+ years of combined experience in data center or mission-critical project management and technical operations.
Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects with defined schedules, budgets, and technical acceptance criteria.
2+ years of experience in a technical role in Critical Facilities Operations or Maintenance Operations with exposure to mechanical, electrical, and controls systems, OR
2+ years of experience in industrial Construction or Commissioning in a technical capacity, OR
2+ years of Project Management experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Proficiency in interpreting and reviewing technical documents such as commissioning reports, TAB reports, electrical and mechanical drawings, and equipment submittals.
Excellent time management and organizational skills and the ability to define these areas for other teams and team members.
Ability to create teams from various departments and work in a high-level collaborative environment while promoting a teamwork mentality.
Ability to initiate, drive, and deliver projects, and communicate plans and findings to internal customers and stakeholders.
Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification preferred.
Ability to travel up to 30% of total work time, including internationally in North America.

Amazon’s EU ATS Amazon Managed Planning Team develop and implement scalable solutions for Amazon to manage it's middle mile network. In this project management role, you will ensure successful execution across a portfolio of large-scale commercial projects that include many of our current and legacy lighting control systems, window system solutions, and innovative smart-building products. The successful candidate will demonstrate exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and strong commercial and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage complex projects from solution design through commissioning and post-occupancy support. This role requires a proactive individual who can navigate technical, operational, and customer challenges, drive cross-functional collaboration, and ensure successful project outcomes while maximizing customer satisfaction, service revenue growth, and long-term client relationships. You will have the opportunity to experience many of Lutron’s exciting commercial projects, as you attend site meetings, walk-throughs, and other site visits as needed.

You will build relationships and collaborate with other Lutron teams, such as: Area Sales, Engineering, Customer Service, Pre-Sales, Operations. Responsibilities

Develop and apply a full technical understanding of our Commercial portfolio of lighting control and window system solutions
Design and oversee customized lighting and controls solutions that align with client requirements, operational goals, and industry best practices.
Learn and apply new technology and processes to solve technical and logistical challenges
Represent Lutron at all levels of construction project meetings
Drive resolution to any problems or challenges at a customer jobsite
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex Lutron lighting control, shading, and smart building projects, ensuring successful execution from design through commissioning and handover.
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, resources, budgets, submittals, and risk mitigation strategies to achieve customer milestones and quality standards.
Serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building trusted relationships with owners, developers, consultants, contractors, and facility teams.

Develop and deliver training, coaching, and capability-building programs for partner project managers and delivery teams.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Customer Success, Field Services, and Operations to resolve risks, address capability gaps, and ensure successful customer outcomes.

Job Description:

Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

Job Summary:

Are you a strategic orchestrator who thrives in complex, global environments? We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join our Global Team Management and Inclusion (GTMI) team to lead high-impact initiatives that bridge the gap between complex business challenges and creative, scalable solutions.

This isn't a role for someone who needs a roadmap; this is a role for someone who builds them. You will act as a change agent, driving global programs from inception to delivery, exercising sound judgment, and maintaining autonomy to steer stakeholders toward successful outcomes without needing a "safety net."

Key Responsibilities:

You won’t just be maintaining programs; you will be evolving our organizational intelligence. You will serve as the primary architect and driver for several high-visibility pillars:

AI School Strategy & Governance: You will be at the forefront of our enterprise-wide AI transformation. This includes modernizing the AI School, scaling content, and launching targeted programs (including AI communication and the integration of our internal OptU site) to ensure our workforce remains ahead of the curve.
Global Udemy Rollout: You will act as the end-to-end program lead for the global deployment of Udemy Enterprise. This is a high-stakes initiative requiring you to synchronize stakeholders across multiple time zones and secure alignment from senior leadership on adoption strategies that drive real business value.
End-to-End New Hire Experience: As a core contributor to our global end-to-end new hire redesign (OnboardU), you will influence the future of how we bring talent into the company. You will ensure that learning priorities and GTMI standards are seamlessly woven into a world-class, global onboarding experience.
Portfolio Excellence & Innovation: You will own the evolution of our core training assets, partnering with cross-functional program managers to shape the soft-skill capabilities of our global organization.

What You’ll Own

Global Strategic Partnership: Consult with business leaders worldwide to prioritize and solve complex, variable-factor problems.
Executive Presence & Facilitation: You are the face of your programs. You will own meetings with senior leadership, facilitate high-stakes discussions, and drive consensus. We value your ability to manage expectations, provide clear, concise communication, and follow through with a rigor that requires minimal oversight.
Change Leadership: As a catalyst for improvement, you will proactively identify issues, perform root-cause analyses, and implement solutions that evolve our business operations.

What You Bring

Proven Track Record: 8+ years of experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience). You have a history of navigating complex organizational structures and resolving issues that require more than a "textbook" approach.
Communication Mastery: You possess the ability to distill complex data into actionable insights for leadership. You know when to seek input from senior stakeholders and when to lead with confidence.
Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable working on issues where variables are constantly shifting, and you have the critical judgment to select the right techniques to achieve success.
Global Mindset: You understand that one size rarely fits all. You apply global nuances to your strategies, ensuring our programs are effective, inclusive, and scalable.
Continuous Improvement: You are proactively identifying opportunities to improve programs, processes and ways of working.
Measurement and Impact: You define success measures, evaluate effectiveness, and use data/insights to continuously improve outcomes.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree plus 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree plus 6 years
Demonstrated experience in instructional design, needs assessment, root cause analysis, and proactive stakeholder management.
A "Team Lead" mindset—you possess the capability to coordinate personnel and influence outcomes without relying on next-level management for daily direction.
Knowledge and experience in implementing AI training and global deployment of Udemy/online training is a plus.

Why This is a Career-Defining Opportunity

Innovation-First: You aren't just managing existing processes; you are designing the future of learning and AI capability at Rakuten.
Global Influence: You will facilitate decisions that impact employees across every region, acting as a key advisor to leadership on how we scale our culture and technical skills.
End-to-End Ownership: From vendor selection and strategic planning to global rollout and adoption, you will own the full lifecycle of these initiatives, providing you with a platform to showcase your leadership and strategic vision.

If you are a builder who thrives on influencing global strategy and want to leave a lasting mark on Rakuten, we want to hear from you.

Five Principles for Success

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, Always Advance
- Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen

Passionately Professional
- Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best

Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika
- Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory

Maximize Customer Satisfaction
- The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile

Speed!! Speed!! Speed!!
- Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

This role is part of the Program Management function, leading cross-functional product development and lifecycle management initiatives that support the delivery, performance, compliance, and continuous improvement of neurovascular products.

new_jobs.description:
Department:
Development
Location:
Melville, NY
Compensation:

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

As a member of the KWI team you will receive

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Our commitment to you

At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

With a commitment to maintaining a bias-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. We expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.

With ground-breaking brain science, path-breaking performances, creative start-ups, big data, big ambitions, hands-on learning, and a whole lot of robots, CMU doesn’t imagine the future, we invent it. Carnegie Mellon University’s Center for Executive Education in Technology Policy (CEE-TP) provides executive education for leaders in roughly one hundred developing countries around the world. Our program helps participants make a difference in their organizations, and in turn helps their nations make informed decisions on policy issues that affect entire societies. The Program Manager works with the Center Director and others to ensure the efficient execution of the programs provided by CEE-TP. Provide strategic planning and coordination of both online and in-person classes, as well as other educational activities such as seminars and mentorship programs.
Perform administrative management for many center activities. This includes logistics for classes conducted at CMU and in foreign countries which range from site selection to travel arrangements to audio/video support to translation services, as well as contract and vendor management.
Collaborate with outside stakeholders and funders in the development and provision of educational programming

Our team is composed of industry experts with deep experience in cybersecurity, automation, and AI-driven solutions. Backed by leading investors, we are rapidly growing and seeking top talent to join our mission of revolutionizing the AI-Native MDR landscape.

We’re a fast-growing startup backed by industry experts and top-tier investors led by Crosspoint Capital Partners and also backed by Shield Capital, DTCP (formerly Deutsche Telekom Capital Partners), Deepwork Capital, and the Florida Opportunity Fund. Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As an early employee, you’ll play a meaningful role in defining and building our culture. Get in on the ground floor. We’re a small but well-funded team that just raised a substantial round – joining now comes with limited risk and unlimited upside.

As the Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) at TENEX, you will be a strategic leader responsible for orchestrating the delivery of our most complex AI-native security initiatives. You will drive cross-functional programs that bridge the gap between frontier AI research, infrastructure engineering, and security operations. This high-impact role requires a sophisticated blend of technical program management expertise, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threat landscapes, and the ability to navigate the operational challenges of deploying AI at scale in high-stakes environments.

Location: San Jose, CA or Kansas City, KS. Hybrid work model.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technical programs, ensuring alignment between AI research, engineering, and security detection teams to meet critical product milestones.
AI Operationalization: Establish and manage the frameworks for scaling AI-driven security capabilities, from prototype development to production-grade deployment and ongoing lifecycle management.
Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks across distributed teams, ensuring seamless integration of AI models within the MDR pipeline.

new_jobs.description:
Division: Weir Minerals

Location: Mexico (remote)

What We Do At Weir

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact

As the T&A Project Manager for North America (NAM),
you will lead the implementation and successful delivery of Time & Attendance solutions across the region, ensuring project plans are effectively executed and key milestones are achieved.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role,
combining project governance with active involvement in project execution. Acting as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders, implementation partners, and program leadership, you will manage delivery activities, vendor performance, stakeholder engagement, and business readiness initiatives to ensure successful, compliant, and sustainable T&A deployments.

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Governance: Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, governance frameworks, and documentation, ensuring alignment with global program objectives, regional business needs, and implementation partner methodologies.
Project Delivery & Vendor Management: Lead end-to-end T&A implementations across North America, coordinating cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors to deliver all project phases, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, go-live, and transition to ongoing support.
Risk, RAIDD & Readiness Management: Manage RAIDD governance, proactively identifying risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies, while overseeing mitigation plans, stage-gate readiness assessments, operational preparedness, and go-live approvals across multiple countries and business units.
Change Management & Adoption: Partner with change, communications, and training teams to drive business readiness, user adoption, process standardization, and successful implementation of future-state workforce management processes, balancing global standards with regional operational and compliance requirements.
Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement: Provide project reporting and executive communications, including status updates, milestone tracking, project health indicators, resource and budget impacts, governance materials, and escalation of critical issues, while building strong relationships with business and leadership stakeholders.
Safety First: Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

What You’ll Bring

Must-haves:

2 - 5 years leading Time & Attendance (T&A), Workforce Management (WFM), or Timekeeping system implementations
Experience delivering end-to-end projects across multiple countries, including vendor and implementation partner management.
Proficiency with workforce management platforms such as ADP eTime, ADP Essential, ADP EZ Labour, UKG, WorkForce Software, Dayforce, SAP SuccessFactors Time, Workday Time Tracking, or similar solutions.
Strong understanding of T&A processes, Payroll/HRIS integrations, RAIDD governance, project reporting, and executive stakeholder communication.
Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves:

Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), or equivalent project management certification
Agile, Scrum, or other project delivery certifications
Experience supporting workforce management programs in North America, including knowledge of labor regulations, workforce scheduling, and timekeeping compliance across multiple countries.
Experience working in global transformation initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.

Why join Weir?

We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. Major companies with Austin campuses, such as Dell, National Instruments, Apple, IBM, Samsung, Google and many others, continue to recruit Cockrell School students at a remarkable rate, launching thousands of successful careers and developing Texas Engineers into industry leaders.

The Construction Industry Institute (CII) is a leading research unit at the University of Texas at Austin. For over 40 years, CII has brought together academics and industry volunteers from its 100+ member organizations to improve the management of capital projects through applied research that drives innovation and excellence in the construction industry. Competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)

Purpose

Research Portfolio Management

Serve as the primary resource for information related to CII’s research portfolio, including project status, schedules, activities, participation, and outcomes

Maintain the master research calendar, coordinating research team activities, committee meetings, project milestones, deliverables, and related events

Administer research data within Salesforce and other designated systems, including research team records, idea repositories, team rosters, attendance, project information, and related documentation
Develop and maintain research workflows, process documentation, and RACI matrices to define roles, responsibilities, approvals, and project requirements
Coordinate the preparation, publication, and distribution of research information through CII webpages, wikis, email communications, eblasts, and other communication channels
