Research Team Management

Manage and monitor research team activities throughout the project lifecycle, including project initiation, progress tracking, deliverable review, presentation preparation, and project closeout
Track research objectives, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and action items, and provide status information to appropriate stakeholders
Manage the annual Request for Qualifications process, including solicitation, submission tracking, evaluation coordination, selection documentation, and applicant communications
Manage the annual Request for Nominations process, including member outreach, nomination tracking, deadline coordination, documentation, and reporting
Coordinate research team kickoff meetings and related launch activities in collaboration with CII events staff and research leadership
Maintain research team records, project documentation, meeting materials, and decision histories

Research Committee Support

Coordinate the operational activities of the Research Committee in consultation with committee leadership and the Director of Research
Plan and organize Research Committee meetings, including schedules, agendas, presentation materials, supporting documentation, and meeting logistics
Prepare draft slides, agendas, reports, briefing materials, and other documents for committee review and use
Document committee decisions, directives, action items, and follow-up requirements
Coordinate implementation of Research Committee decisions across the research portfolio and individual research projects
Facilitate communication between the Research Committee, research teams, CII staff, academic partners, and other stakeholders
Translate committee direction into operational plans, project activities, timelines, and deliverable requirements

Budget Management

Coordinate development and administration of the research budget in collaboration with the Director of Research and CII Financial Services staff
Prepare preliminary budget drafts, expenditure reports, cost projections, and other financial information based on current and anticipated research activities
Maintain historical records of research project costs, expenditures, commitments, and funding activity
Track and reconcile research expenditures against approved budgets and financial records
Monitor anticipated project costs and provide financial information to support budget forecasting and planning
Prepare routine and ad hoc budget reports for research leadership and CII Financial Services staff

Contract Oversight

Coordinate the initiation, review, routing, execution, and completion of research-related contracts and agreements
Serve as a liaison between research staff, academic partners, CII Financial Services staff, and other stakeholders during the contracting process
Track contract documentation, approvals, deadlines, status, and outstanding actions
Maintain contract records and communicate status updates to appropriate stakeholders
Coordinate contract and payment activities in accordance with applicable CII and University of Texas policies and procedures
Review contracting and payment processes and recommend improvements to research-related workflows

Academic and Research Program Support

Coordinate with CII events and communications staff to support academic programs, research presentations, student poster sessions, and researcher-industry engagement activities
Collect, organize, and provide research information needed for academic initiatives, meetings, publications, presentations, and events
Coordinate communications with academic partners, researchers, committee members, and other stakeholders
Manage the review and publication of academic and research content, including proofreading, formatting, routing, approval coordination, and publication
Coordinate research team quality assurance and quality control activities, including progress updates, issue tracking, deliverable reviews, revisions, and approvals
Track research deliverables and coordinate submission, review, revision, and completion requirements
Coordinate research team rehearsals and presentation preparation in collaboration with CII event managers
Support research lifecycle activities, including kickoff meetings, progress reviews, deliverable reviews, presentations, and project closeout

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
Five years of experience in project coordination, research administration, project management, or program management
Demonstrated experience with data management, business intelligence, reporting, and financial tracking
Proficiency in Power BI or a similar business intelligence tool for dashboard development and data visualization
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce for data management and reporting
Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and financial tracking
Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage deadlines and multiple complex projects
Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining accurate, current data
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and implement process improvements
Service-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate information to various stakeholders

Relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with budget management and financial reporting
Background in construction, engineering, or a related technical field
Experience working with academic researchers, industry professionals, or other volunteer stakeholders

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM)
new_jobs.description:
About Orbital Operations

Orbital Operations builds high-thrust, space-resident vehicles for defense and logistics. Space today lacks mobility. Satellites maneuver slowly and with limited range, while adversaries already operate dynamically on orbit, and U.S. response time is measured in months when it needs to be hours. That is a mobility problem, and we are solving it with Astraeus, a reusable, high-thrust orbital vehicle that brings launch-vehicle-class maneuver into orbit.

Astraeus is powered by Typhon, our LH2/LOx engine, and enabled by Boreas, our proprietary cryogenic propellant management system that eliminates boil-off through low-loss cryogenic storage, reverse Brayton cycle thermal control, and turbomachinery-driven propulsion. The result is long-duration storage and use of cryogenic propellants in space for the first time, delivering 100x higher thrust and 10x greater range than existing systems and making sustained, high-energy maneuver viable in geosynchronous and cislunar orbits.

Astraeus is a platform, not a point solution. By separating maneuver from payload, it becomes a reusable host for interceptors, sensors, and logistics, a new class of space-resident infrastructure that repositions, deploys, and responds on demand. Beyond defense, the same capability transforms commercial orbital logistics, cutting LEO-to-GEO transit times from six months to as little as eight hours and unlocking satellite servicing and deployment at a pace the industry has never had. Join us in building the infrastructure for a maneuverable, mission-ready space domain.

About The Role

We just won the contracts. Now we have to deliver them, and you are the person who makes that happen. As our first Technical Program Manager, you personally own execution of our funded government programs from kickoff through delivery. Cost, schedule, risk, and every deliverable the government is owed runs through you.

You are our first dedicated program manager, which means there is no process to inherit and real room to leave your mark. You will build the scheduling, risk, and reporting infrastructure that our program management function grows from, embedded in the team and working shoulder to shoulder with our engineers, mission operations, and leadership every day, translating between the technical work and the programmatic commitments. The templates and cadences you establish become the company standard, and strong performance in this seat puts you first in line to lead the function as it grows.

The role is technical on purpose. Our programs commit us to real engineering outcomes on a cryogenic orbital vehicle, and tracking milestones without understanding what is inside them does not work here. You will sit in design reviews, follow the technical tradeoffs, and be credible in the room with both our engineers and the customer's technical staff. To be clear on the seam, our engineers author the technical work and own the technical decisions. Your job is to be proficient enough to collaborate closely with them, synthesize their findings into program-level status the customer can act on, and connect the technical picture to cost, schedule, and risk.

Responsibilities

Program execution. Day-to-day management of our funded programs, including the integrated master schedule, milestone and deliverable tracking, action item management, and program battle rhythm. You drive every deliverable to on-time submission.
Government deliverables and reporting. The full deliverable package our customers are owed, including CDRLs, milestone review packages, status reports, and financial reporting inputs, with technical report content authored by engineering and compiled and delivered by you. Our contracts carry growth potential well beyond the funded base, and a clean deliverable record is what unlocks it.
Risk management. Build and maintain the program risk matrix, drive mitigation before risks become slips, and make sure leadership hears about problems while they are still cheap to fix.
Requirements and verification tracking. Partner with our engineers to keep contract requirements, verification status, and ICDs organized and current. Engineering owns the requirements content and verification approach, you own that the traceability from contract commitment to verified artifact is tracked, visible, and never surprises the customer.
Design review coordination. Manage the design review cadence (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) from the program seat, including scheduling, entrance and exit criteria tracking, action item closure, and customer sign-off. Engineering authors the review content and presents the technical work, you keep the process on track, unblock whatever engineering or the customer needs on the schedule and hardware front, and make sure reviews happen on time and land well.
Technical performance visibility. Work with our systems engineering and vehicle leads, who own the mass, power, and propellant budgets, to keep technical margin status visible alongside cost and schedule, and flag margin erosion early with its program impact quantified so tradeoffs get made deliberately.
Customer interface. Serve as the day-to-day point of contact with government program managers, CORs, and contracting officers on active contracts, and hold your own with their technical staff.
Cross-functional coordination. Keep engineering, mission operations, and supply chain aligned to contract milestones, and surface resource conflicts before they become schedule problems.
Process buildout. Create the WBS structures, scheduling discipline, risk registers, and reporting templates that become the company's program management foundation.
Proposal support. Support cost volumes, basis of estimates, and execution plans for new pursuits with realistic schedules and technical execution detail.

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years managing technical program execution on aerospace or defense programs, with hands-on ownership of schedules, deliverables, and risk, not just support roles on someone else's program
Demonstrated fluency with the core programmatic toolkit, including integrated master schedules, milestone and deliverable tracking, risk matrices, and milestone-based cost tracking. You will be asked to walk through artifacts you personally built and maintained
A proven history working on technical problems and managing hardware-focused technical programs, with the ability to follow system-level tradeoffs and engage credibly in design reviews. A technical degree is a bonus, demonstrated technical fluency is the requirement
Experience with government customers, ideally DoD, including deliverable management and direct interaction with program offices and contracting officers
Familiarity with OTs, SBIR/STTR, or other non-traditional contract vehicles is a strong plus
Comfort operating without an existing process, since you will be building the process
Experience with ITAR/EAR environments and eligibility to obtain a security clearance

What Success Looks Like

Base period milestones on our funded programs delivered on time and on budget, with a deliverable record clean enough that the government expands the work with confidence
Follow-on phases and contract growth secured on the strength of clean execution
A program management foundation, including schedules, risk registers, and review cadences, that would survive a customer program review and that new hires can be onboarded into
Government customers who know exactly where their program stands at all times

new_jobs.title: Regional Safety & Security Manager, Americas
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As Anthropic scales across the Americas, the Regional Safety & Security Manager (RSSM), Americas is the single operational owner of safety and security execution for every Anthropic location in the region. Our global function leaders set the standards — for physical security design, enterprise risk, and environmental health & safety. The RSSM is the leader who employs those standards in the field: directing the campus security managers, the regional systems integration team, the safety practitioners, and the contract guard force that protect our people, facilities, and research every day.

This is a senior leadership role with real ownership. You own the region’s safety and security posture, its people, and its budget, and you are accountable for outcomes at every site.

Responsibilities

Regional operations: Own end-to-end safety and security operations for all Americas sites, protecting employees, visitors, assets, and AI research while maintaining ASL compliance.
Team leadership: Lead the region’s safety and security team — campus security managers, the Americas systems integration team, EH&S regional staff, and contracted guard-force partners. Set direction, develop talent, and manage performance.
Incident command: Serve as regional incident commander for critical incidents and emergencies; build and exercise emergency-response plans with local law enforcement and emergency services.
Standards execution: Implement and localize the global standards set by the Physical Security Design, Enterprise Risk, and EH&S global function leaders — consistently across the region, adapted to site and jurisdiction — and feed field intelligence back to keep standards sharp.
Budget and vendors: Own the regional safety and security budget and vendor portfolio; drive cost-effective coverage, guard-post standards, and service quality.
New sites: Collaborate with new-site leadership teams on security risk assessments, security design input, and pre-opening readiness, supporting the transition to steady-state operations.
Partnerships: Build trusted relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, and government partners across the region; represent Anthropic in regional public-safety forums.
Culture: Champion an approachable safety and security culture that enables — rather than restricts — a fast-moving research organization.

You may be a good fit if you

Have 10+ years of progressive safety and/or security leadership, including multi-site or regional responsibility and direct people leadership.
Have led sizable teams (staff and vendor/guard forces) of 50 or more and owned meaningful operating budgets in excess of $10M.
Have served as incident commander for complex, high-stakes incidents and built emergency-response capability.
Have delivered the security scope for complex capital facility projects — a new buildout or major renovation — from design through activation.
Have built durable partnerships with law enforcement, emergency services, and government agencies.
Communicate credibly with executives and front-line staff alike, and can influence across a matrixed organization without relying on direct authority.
Are willing to travel regularly across Americas sites and support a 24/7 on-call posture.

Strong candidates may have

A public-safety, law-enforcement, or military command background successfully transitioned into corporate security leadership.
Experience managing large teams of 100 or more and multimillion-dollar budgets ($25M and up) across multiple disciplines — safety programs, security technology teams, dispatch function, training and compliance.
Direct delivery of a capital security/facility project (e.g., a new operations center or campus) from design through opening.
A track record building critical-incident and workplace-violence-prevention programs.
Certifications such as CPP or PSP; ICS/FEMA incident-command training; active ASIS/InfraGard engagement.
A bachelor’s degree (master’s preferred) in a relevant field.
Experience in high-profile technology, research, or otherwise regulated environments.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$280,000—$340,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. current threat context (Threat Situational Awareness and Vulnerability Management).

Intelligence reports and briefings for clients and internal groups (e.g., CSIRT, RTSM, RED 
TEAM).

information into strategic insights.

relevant intelligence reports based on findings.

and presentations in English.

with cyber threats.

intelligence production efficiency.

dedicated malware analysis/reverse engineering team when necessary.

At Cotality, we are driven by a single mission—to make the property industry faster, smarter, and more people-centric. Cotality is the trusted source for property intelligence, with unmatched precision, depth, breadth, and insights across the entire ecosystem. Our talented team of 5,000 employees globally uses our network, scale, connectivity and technology to drive the largest asset class in the world. Join us as we work toward our vision of fueling a thriving global property ecosystem and a more resilient society.

Cotality is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive work culture that inspires innovation and bold thinking; it's a place where you can collaborate, feel valued, develop skills and directly impact the real estate economy. We know our people are our greatest asset. At Cotality, you can be yourself, lift people up and make an impact. By putting clients first and continuously innovating, we're working together to set the pace for unlocking new possibilities that better serve the property industry.

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Professional Business Analyst to lead end-to-end, cross-functional process optimization initiatives. In this role, you will analyze complex workflows, apply lean/re-engineering methodologies, design metrics, and facilitate change to drive operational excellence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Process Optimization & Execution: Independently scope, plan, and execute complex process improvement initiatives across diverse business functions.
Analysis & Problem Solving: Map and evaluate existing workflows, using root-cause analysis to pinpoint operational bottlenecks, performance shortfalls, and inefficiencies.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Assemble, facilitate, and lead multi-disciplinary project teams to deliver high-impact business solutions on time and within scope.
Data & Performance Measurement: Establish advanced operational metrics, KPI dashboards, and leading indicators to track process efficiency and drive continuous improvement.
Strategic Advisory: Consult with senior stakeholders on business process re-engineering (BPR) techniques to enhance quality, speed, and overall performance.
Reporting & Presentation: Develop analytical reports and present data-driven recommendations, control plans, and methodology frameworks to key stakeholders.
Mentorship & Mentoring: Guide, train, and coach junior Business Analysts in process methodologies, data tools, and problem-solving techniques.

Job Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field preferred
Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in business analysis, operations management, or process engineering.
Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in business analysis frameworks, process re-engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), and quantitative data analysis.
Project & Team Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and managing end-to-end improvement projects independently.
Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with a proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities with a data-first approach to diagnosing operational challenges.

Annual Pay Range

77,700 - 90,000 USD

Application Window

This opportunity is expected to remain posted through the date identified below, subject to business needs.

2026-08-17

From a flexible working model to competitive time off and standout health coverage with meaningful perks and growth opportunities, our package is built to help you thrive at work and in life.

Highlights, Depending On Role Classification, Include

Time off: Generous PTO and 11 paid holidays, plus well-being and volunteer time off.
Family Support: Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave and a baby stipend.
Health: Multiple medical plan options with mental health and wellness support offerings.

Extras: Recognition Rewards, Referral bonuses, exclusive discounts and more!

You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

Job Track Description:

Role Summary

We are looking for a Level 2 Application Support Engineer with hands-on experience in application support, troubleshooting, incident management, basic SQL, IIS, and Windows/Linux server environments. The role requires strong analytical thinking, customer-service orientation, documentation discipline, and the ability to manage incidents through triage, prioritization, escalation, tracking, and timely resolution in a 24/7 rotational support model.

Key Responsibilities

Troubleshoot and provide support for customer-facing applications developed on Microsoft technologies.
Investigate and resolve IIS, webhosting, application availability, and application performance-related issues.
Perform basic troubleshooting for Windows and Linux server-related application issues.
Use basic SQL queries to support diagnosis, validation, reporting, and incident resolution activities.
Manage incidents through proper triage, prioritization, escalation, tracking, and timely resolution in line with operational processes.
Document troubleshooting steps, findings, resolution details, and recurring issue patterns clearly.
Work with production control processes and follow operational procedures for incident and request handling.
Communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and stakeholders during issue triage and resolution.

Mandatory Skills And Experience

Minimum 2 years of experience in application support; overall experience range preferred: 2 to 4 years.
Level 2 support experience is required.
Application support, troubleshooting knowledge with demonstrated analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
Hands-on experience in SQL query-writing knowledge.
Good understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems.
Exposure infrastructure technologies such as Windows Servers, Middleware, Linux, and networking.
Good production control literacy and operational process awareness.
Incident Management experience, including ticket handling, impact assessment, escalation coordination, and closure documentation.
Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
Willingness to work in 24/7 rotational shifts, including night shifts.

Good-to-Have Skills

Knowledge of IIS and web-hosting concepts.
Basic batch scripting knowledge.
Experience supporting applications in production environments with customer service responsibilities.

3+ years of Salesforce Analytics (i.e., Wave/Einstein Analytics/Tableau CRM) experience

Technical expertise regarding data models, database design, data visualizations (i.e., Tableau), and development

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an AI Learning Project Manager, you will be tasked with driving strategic initiatives that elevate the employee experience and deliver operational impact. You will be instrumental in optimizing internal processes, leveraging technology, and fostering a culture of efficiency across the organization. You will contribute to the development and execution of AI learning programs designed to enhance employee skills, incorporate deep engagement, and empower our global staff to grow and adopt a productive, AI-infused operational mindset.

Coordinate AI learning projects end-to-end, support learning needs analysis, and measure outcomes through SMART goals; research, evaluate, and recommend productivity tools and software solutions; and support learning efforts from planning to execution.

Promote and coordinate change management processes to ensure the successful adoption of new operational habits with AI, automated workflows, and technologies.
Collect, analyze, and interpret data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives, and help generate regular reports for leadership.
Contribute to developing and maintaining a centralized knowledge base to promote information sharing and reduce redundant effort.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

2 or more years of experience as an AI Learning professional or project manager, managing learning projects and driving training engagements, preferably within a fast-paced technology or cybersecurity company.
Proficiency with Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications and expertise in productivity tools and platforms (e.g., project management software like Jira / Asana / Monday, collaboration tools like Slack / Teams, automation tools like Workato / Make / n8n, and AI tools like Claude / Gemini / NotebookLM).
Proficiency in developing adult learning training materials using blended methods (i.e., eLearning, webinars, video tutorials, presentations, etc.).
Experience and ability to effectively prepare and deliver presentations, with readiness to facilitate training activities and events for global audiences.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build relationships across a global organization.
Ability to efficiently navigate between multiple projects and manage multiple project priorities with close attention to detail.
Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights by tracking key training metrics, with strong analytical skills to collect, interpret, and present data to drive informed decisions.
Passion for continuous learning and knowledge in advanced tooling and AI-based models that enhance productivity, with eagerness to explore, evaluate, and implement cutting-edge solutions as a self-starter with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

The Opportunity:

With all of the information available today, it takes a skilled all-source analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government and military every day, we need an intelligence analyst like you to do just that. As a defense industries all-source analyst, you use your specialized functional experience and your attention to detail to conduct all-source analytic production on foreign defense industrial programs, infrastructure, and capabilities supporting a foreign country’s ability to develop, equip, sustain, and employ its military forces across basic, strategic, and military industrial sectors.

As a Defense Industries All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll help your client by providing intelligence production and briefing support to address dynamic intelligence requirements. Using your comprehensive understanding of all-source analytic tradecraft, production cycles, publication standards, community writing styles, and formats, you’ll produce strategic-level assessments and products that address the research, development, acquisition, test, evaluation and production of foreign weapon systems and equipment. As an authority on your topic, your client will look to you for comprehensive production, often under pressure. This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skillset in areas like analysis, writing, and communication. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Knowledge of IC and Combatant Command environments
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings

Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience in all-source analysis, or 7+ years of experience in all-source analysis in lieu of a degree

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.  welocalize.com  

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Welocalize is seeking a Multilingual Data Annotation Project Manager for an initial 1-year contract to join our global localization delivery team. In this role, you will lead the execution, validation, and delivery of high-volume multilingual localization and quality assurance (LQA) projects for our enterprise clients. You will act as the key operational bridge between client-side teams, in-country linguistic reviewers, translation vendors, and internal talent communities to ensure multilingual assets are culturally aligned, linguistically flawless, and delivered on schedule. 

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage end-to-end localization projects, including scope planning, resource allocation, schedule tracking, and final delivery of multilingual content.

Prepare comprehensive project briefs, handoff packages, linguistic quality guidelines, and progress trackers for global teams.

Coordinate and onboard in-country reviewers, freelance linguists, subject matter experts (SMEs), and translation vendors.

Partner with Quality Specialists to operationalize Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) frameworks, scorecards, error typologies, and evaluation rubrics.

Monitor project financials, budgets, and operational margins to ensure service delivery aligns with established KPIs.

Run quality checks, facilitate reviewer calibration sessions, and manage feedback loops to resolve linguistic differences and improve output consistency.

Support client relationship management by serving as a primary operational contact, proactively managing project risks, and quickly addressing delivery blockers.

JOB REQUIREMENTS 

Proven project management experience in a fast-paced, client-centric environment within the translation or localization industry.

Deep understanding of localization lifecycles, internationalization (i18n) readiness, and translation quality evaluation (TQE) processes.

Practical experience working with Translation Management Systems (TMS) and Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools (such as Smartling, Phrase, XTM, or Crowdin).

Strong capability in coordinating virtual, diverse teams of linguists and localization vendors across multiple global time zones.

Solid experience managing project budgets, scope-of-work changes, and financial tracking systems.

Experience utilizing bug-tracking and project management systems (such as Jira and Confluence) to track linguistic errors, validation feedback, and project tasks.

OTHER SKILLS

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex operational requirements.

Exceptional organizational and problem-solving abilities, with a strong attention to detail.

High level of resilience and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities under tight turnaround times and budget constraints.

Strong interpersonal skills to build trust, resolve disputes, and maintain collaborative relationships with both external clients and global suppliers.

Active curiosity and a proactive mindset to continuously evaluate, document, and improve manual workflow steps.

About Epirus

Epirus is a high-growth technology company dedicated to overcoming the asymmetric challenges inherent to the future of national security. Epirus' flagship product, Leonidas, is a software-defined system built using intelligent power management techniques which allow power-hungry systems to do more with less.

Job Summary:
This is an exciting role in an innovative, high-growth defense technology company. Under an agile development framework, Technical Project Managers at Epirus serve as both scrum masters and product owners, leading research and development projects from initial planning through delivery of first-article solutions. Epirus products are typically developed ahead of customer involvement and requirements, so engineers rely on product owners, usually a TPM and a Chief Engineer, to understand both short-term priorities and long-term value to the end customer, whom they represent during the R&D phase. In this role, you will work closely with talented engineering and operations teams, reporting to the Manager of Technical Project Management within the Engineering and Technology Organization (ETO).

Responsibilities

Act as the bridge between ETO and other department stakeholders (e.g., marketing, sales, operations) for one or multiple efforts
Ensure that teams are aligned on goals and timelines that enable Epirus to build the best products possible
Create and own agile/hybrid project plans, including schedules, budgets, and other artifacts
Be a servant leader to an interdisciplinary and inter-functional scrum to ensure the team delivers the highest value to Epirus and its customers
Remove obstacles and find creative ways to do things better, faster, and more efficiently
Track the delivery of technical features, ensuring that milestones and deadlines are met. Report progress to relevant stakeholders
Identify potential risks, dependencies, and obstacles, and work proactively to resolve them before they impact the timeline or deliverables
Drive company goals by both delivering on company promises while also foreseeing future opportunities and shaping technology products to be more effective

Basic Qualifications

B.S. in Engineering or a related technical field AND minimum 2 years of relevant project management experience, especially in high-growth startups and aerospace 
Experience with the deployment and integration of hardware and software systems  
Experience with building, leading, and developing small teams of engineers  
Prior systems engineering or software integration experience 
Prior experience hosting and leading both technical and non-technical reviews with cross-functional audiences 
Prior experience building and managing project artifacts like schedules, budgets, and risk registers 

Preferred Skills And Experience

Previous experience using JIRA or other agile-enabling software platforms 
Proficient in MS Project and/or Smartsheet use 
Engineering or Operations leadership program graduate or related experience  
Previous work on DoD Projects 
Superior communication skills 
Collaborative; capable of working across all levels of the organization with limited resources  
Organized, comfortable setting, and achieving goals in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment   

Itar Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

new_jobs.title: Technical Publications Program Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
Team Overview
Anduril’s Technical Publications organization supports complex hardware, software, autonomy, and defense systems across multiple divisions, business lines, and programs. This role gives Technical Publications leadership the current, well-sourced information they need to manage requirements, deliverables, briefings, and follow-through across the department.
Role Specifics
As the Technical Publications Program Analyst, your mission is to keep Technical Publications leadership current, prepared, and able to make decisions without chasing information across the department. You will turn program requirements, contractual deliverables, leadership requests, and cross-functional inputs into clear trackers, briefing materials, and action records that leadership can trust and act on immediately. This role supports the day-to-day operation of the department: requirements tracking, CDRL and DMRL management, leadership briefings, cross-functional coordination, and the business-operations work that supports a growing team. The right candidate keeps the record current, drives open items to completion, and maintains accurate status without prompting.
What You’ll Do
Gather, reconcile, and track technical publication requirements across programs, contracts, standards, and customer deliverables.
Track CDRL, DMRL, and other committed deliverable schedules and keep leadership current on what is due and what has changed.
Build and maintain trackers, decision logs, action records, and status materials that leadership and the Operations Manager rely on.
Prepare briefings, status summaries, planning materials, and decision documents for leadership.
Coordinate cross-functional follow-through across Technical Publications, Mission Readiness, Engineering, Program Management, Training, ILS, Support, and Product.
Support leadership reviews, agendas, pre-reads, action tracking, proposals, and the administrative work that supports department operations.
Handle sensitive business and personnel information with discretion while keeping the record accurate and current.

Required Qualifications

Experience in program analysis, business operations, project coordination, technical operations, or a similar role in an environment with formal requirements or customer deliverables.
Strong written communication and presentation skills, including preparing materials for senior leadership.
Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail across multiple concurrent assignments.
Ability to maintain accurate trackers and status records that others can trust for decision-making.
Ability to reconcile conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders and turn them into a clear current record.
Experience maintaining milestone and deliverable discipline where Draft, Preliminary, and Final states materially change what is considered done.
Must be eligible for Secret and higher security clearance (US).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomy, software, hardware, or another complex technical environment.
Familiarity with CDRLs, DMRLs, formal documentation requirements, or similar deliverable tracking structures.
Experience supporting leadership staff work, operational planning, executive briefings, or program reviews.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration and work-tracking systems.
Familiarity with technical publications, Mission Readiness, ILS, training, or program-management workflows

US Salary Range
$112,000—$149,000 USD
Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:
At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.
Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.
By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Subject Matter Expert in new product introduction for x86 hardware appliances

Create schedules for hardware development and prototyping that align with software development schedule(s) to ensure a smooth transition into system integration
Ensure that quality and reliability objectives are met through hardware validation, manufacturing test, and release management

Identify and mitigate risks through early engagement, bug tracking and cross-functional risk assessment.
Support the Test Engineering team in meeting Design for Test (DFT) objectives.
Facilitate Product Characterization and Component Characterization to derisk DFM issues and assembly defects.
Make recommendations for risk buys based on product architecture and lead time analysis.
Identify cost-reduction opportunities through the development of should cost model and multi-sourcing.
Drive ECO (Engineering Change Order) and implement corrective actions.
Establish Traceability on components to trace the history, location and genealogy through multi-level BOM tracking.
Continuously improve the hardware product lifecycle through retrospectives and best practices.
Lead Post Ramp Qualification (PRQ) process for technical initiatives such as Hard Tooling and Optical Transceivers.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members.

Your Experience

8+ Yrs Experience in product development and manufacturing environment.
Proven experience managing cross-functional teams in NPI program management of x86 hardware platforms.

Strong knowledge of product development processes, including Hardware Validation, Product Characterization, Design for Test, Design for Manufacturing, and Design for Assembly

Experience managing manufacturing processes and identifying cost-reduction opportunities
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

Experience with contract negotiations and commercial discussions
Excellent supplier and material management experience
Demonstrated entrepreneurial approach to Operations management in an ambiguous fast-paced environment handling multiple projects in parallel.
